Episodes.Description: Detectives are troubled to learn that someone has taken an online game too far when a girl goes missing.

Episodes.Title: Law & Order: Special Victims Unit S09E03
Episodes.Description: A teacher claims that a student pursued her after she's charged with raping him.

Episodes.Title: Law & Order: Special Victims Unit S09E04
Episodes.Description: The only witness to a young woman's horrific beating is her mentally challenged daughter.

Episodes.Title: Law & Order: Special Victims Unit S09E05
Episodes.Description: Benson and Stabler investigate the connection between the New York murder of college counselor Kate Simes and her volunteer work at a refugee center working with soldiers tortured in Iraq.

Episodes.Title: Law & Order: Special Victims Unit S09E06
Episodes.Description: Benson comes under fire from fans of a convicted serial killer after a body turns up that greatly resembles his work.

Episodes.Title: Law & Order: Special Victims Unit S09E07
Episodes.Description: Novak confronts ghosts from her past while handling the trial of a schizophrenic serial rapist, who seriously injured Stabler.

Episodes.Title: Law & Order: Special Victims Unit S09E08
Episodes.Description: Detectives find themselves embroiled in the world of ultimate fighting after a young girl's death.

Episodes.Title: Law & Order: Special Victims Unit S09E09
Episodes.Description: When the paternity of a missing young boy is placed into question, Stabler wonders if he really is the father of Kathy's child. Later, Stabler faces the possibility of losing not only his partner but also Kathy and the baby when she and Benson are in an accident.

Episodes.Title: Law & Order: Special Victims Unit S09E10
Episodes.Description: When a polygamist's wife is murdered, he believes it's related to a recent criminal case he was testifying in, but detectives believe it may be connected to his culture.

Episodes.Title: Law & Order: Special Victims Unit S09E11
Episodes.Description: A Park Avenue socialite's body is found in NYC'S Central Park, and Detectives Benson and Stabler initially suspect her wealthy boyfriend.

Episodes.Title: Law & Order: Special Victims Unit S09E12
Episodes.Description: A woman's body is found murdered in a park alongside a man with a bullet in his head - Benson and Special Agent Cooper join forces and suspect "The Woodsman", a serial killer Cooper has tried to catch for years. Lake and Benson begin to question Cooper's true motives when the male victim is later identified as "The Woodsman".

Episodes.Title: Law & Order: Special Victims Unit S09E13
Episodes.Description: Benson and Stabler investigate a tutor after a student is beaten and sexually assaulted, but their investigation soon leads them to another student.

Episodes.Title: Law & Order: Special Victims Unit S09E14
Episodes.Description: The robbery of fertilized embryos from a sperm bank call for Benson and Stabler to track down the thief. Clues from the clinic's security tape lead them to a long list of suspects including two publicity-hungry extremists. The detectives race against the clock to find the missing embryos, but that isn't the only clock that's ticking - Olivia considers her own fertility and the possibility of motherhood.

Episodes.Title: Law & Order: Special Victims Unit S09E15
Episodes.Description: After a woman was found raped in a garden, Benson and Stabler realize that the case goes much deeper because of the victim's mother, drugs, and the realization that a corrections officer is involved. Benson decides to go undercover at the same prison where the mother is, putting herself on the other side of the fence.

Episodes.Title: Law & Order: Special Victims Unit S09E16
Episodes.Description: After investment banker Jeremy Haynes is found dead, suspicions turns to his boyfriend Lincoln Haver, a professional football player who could lose everything if the truth of his sexuality became public. When news of Haver's sexual orientation comes out, Benson comes under fire for her relationship with a reporter.

Episodes.Title: Law & Order: Special Victims Unit S09E17
Episodes.Description: An engineer plays a series of mind games with Benson and Stabler.

Episodes.Title: Law & Order: Special Victims Unit S09E18
Episodes.Description: When a pregnant woman's body is discovered in a burned-out brownstone, the investigation turns to a family of coffee importers.

Episodes.Title: Law & Order: Special Victims Unit S09E19
Episodes.Description: The squad is left at ends when Lake is caught in a gunfight and later takes a witness hostage.

Episodes.Title: Law & Order: Special Victims Unit S10E01
Episodes.Description: After a young boy, Christopher Ryan, is caught driving a runaway van, Detective Elliot Stabler and Detective Benson take the seven year-old into questioning. When Christopher claims his foster parents, Gwen and Noah Sibert, bribe him in exchange for abusive medical testing, the detectives investigate his allegations.

Episodes.Title: Law & Order: Special Victims Unit S10E02
Episodes.Description: Teenage boy Eric Byers admits himself into the squad room, and warns the team about an unnatural desire towards his younger stepbrother, Cory Kelly. Detective Elliot Stabler and Olivia Benson’s suspicions arise, and Eric admits to also looking at a website to try to curb his pedophilic urge. With no crime committed, the detectives decide to investigate this “self-help” website for pedophiles leading them to it’s creator, Jake Berlin. Eric’s rage induced stepfather is also questioned, and shortly after Eric is found missing. The detectives must race to place the clues together to find and stop Eric before any crime is committed.

Episodes.Title: Law & Order: Special Victims Unit S10E03
Episodes.Description: Stabler is shocked when his daughter, Kathleen, becomes the suspect in an investigation to catch a trespasser. He seeks his estranged mother's help in dealing with his daughter's case.

Episodes.Title: Law & Order: Special Victims Unit S10E04
Episodes.Description: The investigation of a famous dead astronaut found in Battery Park has hit a dead end, causing Stabler to ask for assistance from his old mentor, Dick Finley, a former colleague of the victim and an astronaut himself.

Episodes.Title: Law & Order: Special Victims Unit S10E05
Episodes.Description: A baby with AIDS has Benson and Stabler asking for assistance from Warner as they investigate the case. They are pointed in the direction of a homeopathic doctor who has an questionable ethical past and who had prescribed the baby ineffective vitamins.

Episodes.Title: Law & Order: Special Victims Unit S10E06
Episodes.Description: Stabler and Munch uncover a chastity club and a group of girls with a pregnancy pact at a high school where they came to investigate the death of a student.

Episodes.Title: Law & Order: Special Victims Unit S10E07
Episodes.Description: Stabler goes undercover to infiltrate a rare animal smuggling operation.

Episodes.Title: Law & Order: Special Victims Unit S10E08
Episodes.Description: Benson finds herself going the extra mile to protect a woman abused by her spouse. The investigation turns up information regarding a long-forgotten case of 2nd degree murder and escape.

Episodes.Title: Law & Order: Special Victims Unit S10E09
Episodes.Description: The death of a marine who was pregnant by a rapist puts the unit at odds with the Pentagon when they fight to keep the case, and Benson's flashbacks of her own assault may further impede the investigation.

Episodes.Title: Law & Order: Special Victims Unit S10E10
Episodes.Description: A beaten and raped woman who has no memory of what happened to her puts Benson and Stabler on the trail of a serial rapist, but when women refuse to testify Olivia will have to face how her assault has affected her job performance.

Episodes.Title: Law & Order: Special Victims Unit S10E11
Episodes.Description: When a girl who vanished four years ago reappears, she claims to have been imprisoned and sexually abused. Benson and Stabler look into the case and find themselves having to sort through what was fact and what the girl made up.

Episodes.Title: Law & Order: Special Victims Unit S10E12
Episodes.Description: When a teenager's body is uncovered in the Hudson River, the detectives search for the victim's identity which leads Benson to go undercover as a madam.

Episodes.Title: Law & Order: Special Victims Unit S10E13
Episodes.Description: The mother of a kidnapped young girl points the detectives towards her father, an ex-con, but it is soon discovered that the grandfather is a master thief and has many enemies. However, because of Alzheimer's, the grandfather can't remember much of his past.

Episodes.Title: Law & Order: Special Victims Unit S10E14
Episodes.Description: The detectives have very little to work with after a man is found badly-beaten in a strip club's parking lot. Their questioning begins with the dancers until the victim's ex-wife and 13-year old transgender son become suspects.

Episodes.Title: Law & Order: Special Victims Unit S10E15
Episodes.Description: When a pediatrician convicted of abusing patients is found dead, Stabler and Benson investigate and soon find ADA Cabot has a reason for becoming involved in the case.

Episodes.Title: Law & Order: Special Victims Unit S10E16
Episodes.Description: A single murder suddenly turns into a scene with three bodies, leaving Benson and Stabler to work with a strip club owner to find a murderer whose motive may be more about righteousness than perversity.

Episodes.Title: Law & Order: Special Victims Unit S10E17
Episodes.Description: Detective Munch investigates the brutal rape and beating of a young mute girl, but things become tricky when her drawing of the devil who attacked her resembles a local priest who may not be practicing his beliefs according to Canon.

Episodes.Title: Law & Order: Special Victims Unit S10E18
Episodes.Description: A turf war ensues when Stabler and Tutuola link an artist's murder to a serial killer, and the detective assigned to that case focuses more on their involvement in an investigation he believes belongs solely to him than on identifying the killer.

Episodes.Title: Law & Order: Special Victims Unit S10E19
Episodes.Description: A grandmother reports that her 2 year old granddaughter has disappeared, but the Amber Alert fails to yield progress. The detectives then move their attention over to her young irresponsible mother as their prime suspect.

Episodes.Title: Law & Order: Special Victims Unit S10E20
Episodes.Description: A teenage girl who sent text messages containing nude pictures of herself is found beaten up. She next faces a harsh sentence from a judge after being arrested for producing and distributing child pornography.

Episodes.Title: Law & Order: Special Victims Unit S10E21
Episodes.Description: A favor for a judge who is hearing a harassment case sends Stabler and Benson to interview a death-row serial killer in order to determine the fate of his son.

Episodes.Title: Law & Order: Special Victims Unit S10E22
Episodes.Description: A murder in Central Park that involves a tourist puts the SVU on high alert, but when the suspect they've brought in for questioning escapes, Munch has to reach out to an ex-wife in an effort to prevent another killing that's closer to home.

Episodes.Title: Law & Order: Special Victims Unit S11E01
Episodes.Description: Officer Nate Kendall aids a woman in trouble and becomes roped into solving a rape case. While Detectives Elliot Stabler and Olivia Benson believe that Kendall is not right for the case due to his unstable personality, Executive ADA Sonya Paxton joins the team, bringing evidence of a common thread among three other rape cases. With Paxton’s help, the team might expose a serial rapist.

Episodes.Title: Law & Order: Special Victims Unit S11E02
Episodes.Description: A young woman's body is found stuffed inside a suitcase, and police believe that Mindy Keefe, the victim, was a train passenger on her way to Tampa when she was murdered. Detectives Benson and Stabler turn to Keefe's financier boyfriend, Owen Cassidy's yacht to investigate. However, Cassidy claims he was on his boat during the time of the murder. After further searching, the detectives discover Keefe belonged to an online dating website. But when the CEO of the dating website, Vance Shepard, refuses to comment on the case, the detectives turn to ADA Sonya Paxton for help.

Episodes.Title: Law & Order: Special Victims Unit S11E03
Episodes.Description: When Lily Milton is reported missing, her boyfriend, Parker Hubbard, points Detectives Benson and Stabler in the direction of Callum Donovan, Lily's downstairs neighbor and convicted bank robber who spent nineteen years in solitary confinement. During the investigation into Donovan's alibi, Lily is found alive, adding a surprising twist to the case and exposing more of Donovan's dark past.

Episodes.Title: Law & Order: Special Victims Unit S11E04
Episodes.Description: After a night of heavy drinking, Dalton Rindell wakes up to a bloody apartment, a terrible cut on his head and a dead woman in his bed. Unable to recall the night before, Rindell immediately calls the police. Detectives Benson and Stabler suspect the crime is the result of a deadly love triangle; however Rindell does not recognize the victim. After questioning Rindell and the victim’s family and friends, Benson and Stabler are provided with leads in several different directions. Unsure which lead to follow, the two detectives decide to return to the bar where the night began in order to piece together the gruesome truth.

Episodes.Title: Law & Order: Special Victims Unit S11E05
Episodes.Description: After Eva Banks makes a shocking discovery about her son's behavior at school, she takes him to the doctor, only to find out that he has been the victim of sexual abuse. Detectives Benson and Stabler come onto the scene and question the victim and his family.

Episodes.Title: Law & Order: Special Victims Unit S11E06
Episodes.Description: The FBI gets involved in a murder case when it becomes too dangerous for the SVU cops.

Episodes.Title: Law & Order: Special Victims Unit S11E07
Episodes.Description: The team investigates the father of a murdered teenager whose crime scene photo has gone viral on the web, but they believe they've found a more likely suspect when they speak with the girl's therapist. The case becomes more frustrating as alibis exclude suspects and a strange occurrence in the morgue sends them in a different direction.

Episodes.Title: Law & Order: Special Victims Unit S11E08
Episodes.Description: Stabler is torn between a troubling rape case which victim has had pictures posted on the net and his son, whose friend's actions may endanger a life and both of their futures.

Episodes.Title: Law & Order: Special Victims Unit S11E09
Episodes.Description: DNA links Olivia to the murder of a biker in Central Park whose gang specialized in hits and prostitution. With Munch and Fin assigned to the investigation and evidence continuing to mount against Benson, Elliot begins his own inquiry – determined to prove her innocence and save her career.

Episodes.Title: Law & Order: Special Victims Unit S11E10
Episodes.Description: Fin's investigation into three little girl's deaths takes him into the world of immigration, anchor babies, a grassroots opposition movement, a radio talk show host who fans the hatred, and an immigration rights attorney who is somehow tied up in everything.

Episodes.Title: Law & Order: Special Victims Unit S11E11
Episodes.Description: One case becomes two as a murder leads to a serial rapist who is busy spreading disease along with his assaults, and the detectives' only clue is a website set up for casual and anonymous encounters.

Episodes.Title: Law & Order: Special Victims Unit S11E12
Episodes.Description: When a rich and powerful couple with political connections is found murdered in their bedroom, Detectives Olivia Benson and Elliot Stabler decide to speak to the deceased couple's daughter, Anne, for more information. After hearing Anne's account of a nefarious man who has been following her, the detectives soon discover that Anne's supposed stalker is none other than Detective Ash Ramsey of the Special Frauds division. Convinced that Anne killed her parents for their money, Ramsey becomes suspicious of Anne's business manager and is led to believe that he helped her steal money from the foundation she runs. When blackmail and embezzlement come into play, the detectives find that their lives may be at risk over a girl with some serious parent issues.

Episodes.Title: Law & Order: Special Victims Unit S11E13
Episodes.Description: Detectives Olivia Benson and Eliot Stabler find a woman bleeding from the neck and nearly dead. The woman dies before they reach the hospital, and soon the investigation leads them to the frontman of the death metal band Vampyre Sacrifyce. He bites girls, steals blood from the local blood bank and sings about violence to women all in the name of his strange, vampiric lifestyle. The singer claims he was nowhere near the scene of the crime, and soon a lesbian rights group led by Babs Duffy  gets involved, claiming the victim's death was a result of police neglect. However, when more women from Babs's group are attacked, it becomes clear that the victim's case wasn't an isolated incident and that someone out there has a larger plan to bring the group down.

Episodes.Title: Law & Order: Special Victims Unit S11E14
Episodes.Description: When a series of young prostitutes are found murdered with homemade prayer cards attached to their bodies, Detectives Olivia Benson and Eliot Stabler struggle to find the common thread. However, just when they think that they've found the murderer, Captain Donald Cragen informs the detectives that another victim named Gladys has turned up with a prayer card. This time she survived. As the case unfolds, Benson finds herself getting emotionally invested in the survivor until she is forced to make a decision that she isn't ready to face.

Episodes.Title: Law & Order: Special Victims Unit S11E15
Episodes.Description: Benson and Stabler investigate the abduction of a woman in a building owned by a high-powered and highly protected investment banker, but when Munch's memory of an eerily similar crime proves true the focus turns toward potentially freeing an innocent man, and it may take the DA himself to shake loose the truth.

Episodes.Title: Law & Order: Special Victims Unit S11E16
Episodes.Description: Soon after a young girl, Laine McAlister, is raped in her apartment building's stairwell, Detectives Olivia Benson and Eliot Stabler meet Laine in the hospital and find her extremely shaken with a large cut on her hand. After an unpleasant exchange with a man she claims is her boyfriend, the detectives become suspicious that she may have fabricated her rape to get attention. Their suspicions grow when she waits to reveal that there was an eyewitness. As the gravity of the situation intensifies, Benson and Stabler find themselves in a race to track down the witness and get a testimony before it is too late.

Episodes.Title: Law & Order: Special Victims Unit S11E17
Episodes.Description: Detectives Olivia Benson and Eliot Stabler are called in to investigate when a disabled woman, Cara Benson, is beaten and raped. Though the victim's condition has rendered her unable to speak, the detectives soon deduce that someone close to her is responsible, with the lead suspects being her resentful sister and troubled nephew. As the investigation continues, Benson and Stabler strive to make Cara comfortable with coming forward to stand up for herself and illuminating some of the disturbing truths about the assisted living business.

Episodes.Title: Law & Order: Special Victims Unit S11E18
Episodes.Description: When a journalist is found raped and murdered in her own bed, Cragen is able to connect this particular case to another five murders that happened thirty years ago, committed by the "Bedtime Butcher". To uncover the truth behind the crimes, Benson goes undercover in order to find the real killer.

Episodes.Title: Law & Order: Special Victims Unit S11E19
Episodes.Description: A case of mistaken identity complicates the investigation into the murder of whom most believe was an uninvited wedding guest at a hotel in which the body was found.

Episodes.Title: Law & Order: Special Victims Unit S11E20
Episodes.Description: After a young woman is sexually assaulted and murdered, Detectives Olivia Benson and Eliot Stabler track down the woman's boyfriend - their first suspect - but learn that he is a devout vegan who wouldn't hurt a fly. They soon find that the victim had been deeply involved in the fight to expose questionable practices in the meat-packing industry, even going undercover at a large company to find out the truth. Benson goes undercover herself to retrace the woman's footsteps and to identify who the victim might have angered along the way.

Episodes.Title: Law & Order: Special Victims Unit S11E21
Episodes.Description: After two young girls die in a fire, Stabler finds a familiar face in the prosecutor assigned to the case.

Episodes.Title: Law & Order: Special Victims Unit S11E22
Episodes.Description: When a pregnant woman is raped, Detectives Olivia Benson and Eliot Stabler arrive at the hospital to find that she has fled. Even when someone is arrested for a similar offense, ADA Jo Marlowe says she doesn't have a case in court unless they find the victim and get a statement from her. Soon, Benson and Stabler connect the woman to an illegal adoption operation, forcing them to go undercover and expose the truth.

Episodes.Title: Law & Order: Special Victims Unit S11E23
Episodes.Description: After a man flashes customers at an electronics store, it is discovered that someone who matches his description has recently raped three young girls. Captain Donald Cragen orchestrates a movement to catch the rapist, and a rookie cop makes an arrest. Detectives Olivia Benson and Eliot Stabler confirm that they've found their man, but after ADA Jo Marlowe  expresses some doubts, it is soon discovered that the so-called rookie may have some secrets of his own.

Episodes.Title: Law & Order: Special Victims Unit S11E24
Episodes.Description: The detectives end up in a dangerous situation while investigating the whereabouts of a kidnapped eight-year-old boy.

Episodes.Title: Law & Order: Special Victims Unit S12E01
Episodes.Description: Benson and Stabler are called to investigate when a little girl goes missing. They soon find out that the mother had another daughter who disappeared some years earlier and she becomes the focus of the investigation.

Episodes.Title: Law & Order: Special Victims Unit S12E02
Episodes.Description: The brutal rape of a ten-year-old girl leaves her unable to recall her own name. Unfortunately, once Fin assists with the ID, the detectives find that she’s not the only one with memory impairment, and Dr. Huang is brought in to assess her home situation.

Episodes.Title: Law & Order: Special Victims Unit S12E03
Episodes.Description: A woman who has been raped multiple times is afraid to leave her house. The issue of unopened rape kits will see Detective Olivia Benson travel from New York City to Los Angeles.

Episodes.Title: Law & Order: Special Victims Unit S12E04
Episodes.Description: A teenage girl’s death exposes a human trafficking ring and leads detectives Olivia Benson and Elliot Stabler to team up with an old friend at the U.S. Attorney’s office.

Episodes.Title: Law & Order: Special Victims Unit S12E05
Episodes.Description: Detectives Benson and Stabler arrive on the scene where a woman is found dead in Bethesda Fountain. When her squeaky clean image doesn’t match up with her promiscuous actions on the night of her murder, ADA Mikka Von encourages the cops to dig deeper into her past.

Episodes.Title: Law & Order: Special Victims Unit S12E06
Episodes.Description: Two men have been branded and sodomised by someone. Is there a connection between these men, and what nut case is on the loose?

Episodes.Title: Law & Order: Special Victims Unit S12E07
Episodes.Description: A rape and murder investigation puts the detectives lives at risk.

Episodes.Title: Law & Order: Special Victims Unit S12E08
Episodes.Description: Undercover FBI agent Dana Lewis returns to help the detectives with a case.

Episodes.Title: Law & Order: Special Victims Unit S12E09
Episodes.Description: Stabler's participation in a Take Back the Night rally at Kathleen's campus results in an extra case for him and Benson when a student claims she was raped. Unfortunately, the case turns out to be a "he said-she said" type with little evidence. Enter Sonya Paxton, and it can only get more complicated.

Episodes.Title: Law & Order: Special Victims Unit S12E10
Episodes.Description: With young Calvin in her care, Detective Benson continues the search for his drug-addict mother, Vivian, but Detective Stabler notices a strong bond forming between Benson and the boy. When Vivian’s name comes up during a rape investigation, Captain Cragen assigns Detectives Fin and Munch to the case instead. However, it will take more than Cragen’ s orders to keep Benson away.

Episodes.Title: Law & Order: Special Victims Unit S12E11
Episodes.Description: A young boy is found dead on a park carousel after being dropped off by his uncle Joe Gilbert. When Detectives Benson and Stabler learn that the boy was beaten to death they suspect that it could be the result of a bully at school. The investigation leads to an unsettling gambling ring. Detectives suspect that Gilbert's acquaintance, Joe Roberts is beating his wife Sandra and the case takes a horrifying turn.

Episodes.Title: Law & Order: Special Victims Unit S12E12
Episodes.Description: A young man finds that his girlfriend Larissa Welsh has been attacked in her apartment with evidence that points to her buried past. Detectives Benson and Stabler go in search of her attacker and discover that an elderly man, Orville Underwood, may have been involved in traumatic events of Welsh’s past. For the detectives, solving the case comes down to who was in possession of the evidence.

Episodes.Title: Law & Order: Special Victims Unit S12E13
Episodes.Description: Debbie Shields comes home to find her partner Ann Jackson being raped by a man wearing a haunting mask. Shields contacts Ann's father to notify him of her critical condition. As detectives Benson and Stabler interrogate Ann's father, Captain Jackson, his sordid past is revealed filled with sexual and alcohol addiction. Jackson's new role as a sex therapist is hindering the detectives from getting the information they need to solve the case and if Jackson won't comply, the detectives are going to have to get creative.

Episodes.Title: Law & Order: Special Victims Unit S12E14
Episodes.Description: Detective Saliyah "Sunny" Qadri goes in search of Brooklyn District Attorney Page Ferguson, who she fears may be in danger. Qadri finds Ferguson just in time to witness her fall from the top of a parking garage. When Benson arrives, she discovers that the crime scene has been tampered with. Benson turns to an old friend, Assistant U.S. Attorney Christine Danielson for help. As the investigation progresses, Benson begins to question Ferguson’s suspicious past and Qadri’s involvement in the case.

Episodes.Title: Law & Order: Special Victims Unit S12E15
Episodes.Description: When it is discovered that a teenage girl is suffering from Post Traumatic Stress Disorder due to sexual abuse, all leads point to billionaire Jordan Kress. As Detectives Benson and Stabler continue to investigate, Kress involves his lawyer, Dwight Stanitch, who throws the whole case awry.

Episodes.Title: Law & Order: Special Victims Unit S12E16
Episodes.Description: After the sexual assault of a young woman is videotaped and featured on a campus-wide intranet feed, detectives Elliot Stabler and Odafin "Fin" Tutuola go in search of the victim and her attacker. As they delve into the investigation, it becomes clear that the perpetrator created a spectacle to draw attention to his own issues.

Episodes.Title: Law & Order: Special Victims Unit S12E17
Episodes.Description: The TV host of a show that spotlights predators receives threats to her safety, and this reawakens her hunt for her sister's abductor. An ADA with connections to the TV host then assists detectives in their investigation.

Episodes.Title: Law & Order: Special Victims Unit S12E18
Episodes.Description: An art patron finds a body, and when detectives question the murdered woman's good friend and associates, they uncover an antagonistic work environment filled with grown-up bullies.

Episodes.Title: Law & Order: Special Victims Unit S12E19
Episodes.Description: A grifter named Cassandra strikes swinging men who frequent sex clubs.

Episodes.Title: Law & Order: Special Victims Unit S12E20
Episodes.Description: When a young girl is found dead with a doll that is believed to have been left as a totem, detectives Benson and Stabler team up with Captain Jackson, a psychologist who assisted them with a recent case, to investigate her murder. Jackson joins the detectives as they retrace the girl’s last steps and go to meet with her piano teacher June Frye. Jackson’s skills prove to be invaluable in deciphering the meaning of the totem and ultimately finding her killer.

Episodes.Title: Law & Order: Special Victims Unit S12E21
Episodes.Description: Two high-powered attorneys face each other across the aisle when Casey Novak returns to the team, and Joe Dekker takes a leave of absence from his Los Angeles duties after his cousin is charged with rape. Dekker's unwavering belief in his cousin's innocence, and a court disturbance make Novak and Benson take another look at the evidence, which leads them to someone playing a very long game in the name of hatred.

Episodes.Title: Law & Order: Special Victims Unit S12E22
Episodes.Description: When an abandoned baby is found on playground, Detectives Benson and Stabler go in search of the child’s caregiver. Upon meeting the nanny and her boyfriend, Ken Turner, they soon realize that he is also engaged to the baby’s adoptive mother, Dede Aston. As the detectives dig deeper into Turner’s malevolent past, they realize that the law may be on his side.

Episodes.Title: Law & Order: Special Victims Unit S12E23
Episodes.Description: When a young woman finds a teenage boy asleep and naked in her bedroom, his mother, Bree Walsh, is quick to defend him. While Detective Benson and Detective Stabler try to figure out what truly happened, they also have to manage the sneaky teenager and his naive mother. As the detectives dig deeper, they discover how deceptive appearances can be.

Episodes.Title: Law & Order: Special Victims Unit S12E24
Episodes.Description: When a woman is murdered during an afternoon shopping trip with her daughter, Detectives Benson and Stabler are called in because she was scheduled to testify in their high-profile rape case. As the detectives continue to investigate the correlation between the murder and their case, they discover unlikely friendships that will lead them to the truth.

Episodes.Title: Law & Order: Special Victims Unit S13E01
Episodes.Description: An African immigrant working as a maid accuses an Italian diplomat of rape, but is she really in it just for the money? Meanwhile, Stabler's return remains in doubt after his latest shooting.

Episodes.Title: Law & Order: Special Victims Unit S13E02
Episodes.Description: SVU investigates an accusation that a revered high school basketball coach sexually abused his players, but they ultimately may need the cooperation of a reluctant pro superstar to make the case.

Episodes.Title: Law & Order: Special Victims Unit S13E03
Episodes.Description: A pregnant thirteen-year-old girl from Washington Heights claims that the son of an ambassador raped her, but the accused goes missing before SVU can question him.

Episodes.Title: Law & Order: Special Victims Unit S13E04
Episodes.Description: Detective Rollins believes that SVU has caught a serial rapist from one of her earlier cases in Georgia, but a passioned request after a suicide attempt leads Amaro to suspect that they may have the wrong person.

Episodes.Title: Law & Order: Special Victims Unit S13E05
Episodes.Description: Detectives search for a missing baby on Halloween after a young mother from Buffalo tells them her car was stolen while her baby was still in it.

Episodes.Title: Law & Order: Special Victims Unit S13E06
Episodes.Description: The SVU team works together to investigate the case of a promising music student who was brutally raped at gunpoint.

Episodes.Title: Law & Order: Special Victims Unit S13E07
Episodes.Description: In order to bring down a Russian mobster running an international prostitution/kidnapping ring disguised as a Russian bride website, Cragen steps from behind the desk to go undercover.

Episodes.Title: Law & Order: Special Victims Unit S13E08
Episodes.Description: A patient in a mental hospital claims to have witnessed a sexual assault. However, the supposed victim is a fellow patient who has a history of making rape allegations, but she denies being assaulted this time.

Episodes.Title: Law & Order: Special Victims Unit S13E09
Episodes.Description: When a Romani boy vanishes on his way home from school, the Special Victims Unit must penetrate his insular community to find the unlikely abductors.

Episodes.Title: Law & Order: Special Victims Unit S13E10
Episodes.Description: A retired pro quarterback is busted for having sex with a fourteen-year-old prostitute, but he may be suffering from diminished capacity because of all the concussions he had on the field.

Episodes.Title: Law & Order: Special Victims Unit S13E11
Episodes.Description: SVU tries to figure out who was responsible for the real-life rape of an actress during an interactive theater performance that everybody just assumed was part of the show.

Episodes.Title: Law & Order: Special Victims Unit S13E12
Episodes.Description: Benson and Amaro must work around a resistant victim when the CEO of a military contractor is assaulted.

Episodes.Title: Law & Order: Special Victims Unit S13E13
Episodes.Description: A nineteen-year-old creates a hostage situation after his father is accused of sexual assault, and Olivia uses her personal experience to help defuse the situation.

Episodes.Title: Law & Order: Special Victims Unit S13E14
Episodes.Description: After a couple is murdered in their home and their daughter is critically injured, SVU uncovers a number of twisted family secrets, as well as Detective Rollins' gambling addiction.

Episodes.Title: Law & Order: Special Victims Unit S13E15
Episodes.Description: Detectives Benson and Amaro lead the search for a serial killer who is targeting young prostitutes.

Episodes.Title: Law & Order: Special Victims Unit S13E16
Episodes.Description: Detective Benson calls on Bayard Ellis for legal help when her estranged brother gets caught in a child custody battle. Also, Detectives Tutuola and Rollins investigate why a newborn baby is abandoned near a hospital.

Episodes.Title: Law & Order: Special Victims Unit S13E17
Episodes.Description: A closed rape case of Benson's is reopened because of it's similarities to a new case, and the possibility of wrongful imprisonment surfaces. As Benson's work is questioned, tension develops between her, ADA Haden, and Bayard Ellis.

Episodes.Title: Law & Order: Special Victims Unit S13E18
Episodes.Description: A man witnesses his wife's rape and kidnapping while video chatting with her on his way home from a business trip. The abductors seek a ransom, and the case grows more complex as detectives probe deeper.

Episodes.Title: Law & Order: Special Victims Unit S13E19
Episodes.Description: The task of find a serial rapist becomes more difficult when a team of neighborhood vigilante "superheroes" starts trying to avenge the crimes.

Episodes.Title: Law & Order: Special Victims Unit S13E20
Episodes.Description: Detectives search for a missing teenage girl who vanished while looking for her biological father, an anonymous sperm donor. A puzzling prime suspect who's targeted several young women soon emerges.

Episodes.Title: Law & Order: Special Victims Unit S13E21
Episodes.Description: As Fin tries to get justice after his gay son's fiancé is brutally beaten in a hate crime, SVU uncovers a scandal involving a teacher sexually abusing a student at a prep school.

Episodes.Title: Law & Order: Special Victims Unit S13E22
Episodes.Description: The investigation of the homicide of a young woman who recently had her leg amputated sends SVU into the strange culture of body modification.

Episodes.Title: Law & Order: Special Victims Unit S13E23
Episodes.Description: The murder of a prostitute at a bachelor party sends SVU on a dangerous investigation that could lead all the way into the highest reaches of New York power and influence.

Episodes.Title: Law & Order: Special Victims Unit S14E01
Episodes.Description: The squad reels from the fallout of Capt. Cragen being arrested for the murder of an escort.

Episodes.Title: Law & Order: Special Victims Unit S14E02
Episodes.Description: Delia continues cleaning house, leaving a wake of accusations, frame-ups, and murders for SVU to work through as they continue their search for evidence to prove Donald Cragen is being framed.

Episodes.Title: Law & Order: Special Victims Unit S14E03
Episodes.Description: A famous TV host forces himself on the young author of an erotic novel; Detective Amaro uncovers a secret that could damage the author's career and her case.

Episodes.Title: Law & Order: Special Victims Unit S14E04
Episodes.Description: The special victims squad tries to take down a sex-trafficking operation that enslaves young women; when the investigation is halted by Lt. Alexandra Eames, Detective Benson has to get creative.

Episodes.Title: Law & Order: Special Victims Unit S14E05
Episodes.Description: The kidnapping of a young boy reminds Cragen, Munch and Benson of a unsolved case from thirteen years ago.

Episodes.Title: Law & Order: Special Victims Unit S14E06
Episodes.Description: The investigation into a girl's disappearance leads to a high-tech kidnapper who uses the Internet to cover his tracks; Rollins reconnects with her sister.

Episodes.Title: Law & Order: Special Victims Unit S14E07
Episodes.Description: When a woman claims that the baby she kidnapped is hers with a respected legal expert, the investigation changes the lives of two families.

Episodes.Title: Law & Order: Special Victims Unit S14E08
Episodes.Description: As the detectives investigate reports of sexual abuse at an elite private school, decades of secrets are exposed.

Episodes.Title: Law & Order: Special Victims Unit S14E09
Episodes.Description: A man goes on a killing spree, but he has links to a prostitute that Benson encountered in an earlier investigation, so the FBI contacts SVU for information.

Episodes.Title: Law & Order: Special Victims Unit S14E10
Episodes.Description: Holiday celebrations are interrupted when Detective Tutuola's ex-brother-in-law is arrested for attacking a priest; during the investigation, a church scandal is uncovered.

Episodes.Title: Law & Order: Special Victims Unit S14E11
Episodes.Description: When a rape victim is arrested for murder in Suffolk County, Detective Benson questions the case and finds enough evidence for District Attorney Barba to charge a different suspect in Manhattan.

Episodes.Title: Law & Order: Special Victims Unit S14E12
Episodes.Description: The detectives go under cover to arrest a man who brutally attacks other men; a deceptively tough defense attorney complicates ADA Barba's case.

Episodes.Title: Law & Order: Special Victims Unit S14E13
Episodes.Description: When a janitor violently attacks a coach, the SVU team connects the janitor's behavior to a history of sexual abuse; the detectives find more victims of the same predator.

Episodes.Title: Law & Order: Special Victims Unit S14E14
Episodes.Description: FBI Agent Dana Lewis partners with SVU when she thinks a 25-year-old rape-murder case in New York is connected to multiple unsolved cases across the country; as Lewis doggedly pursues her suspect, Benson and Amaro question his guilt.

Episodes.Title: Law & Order: Special Victims Unit S14E15
Episodes.Description: The SVU squad tries to keep Detective Rollins' sister safe from her abusive boyfriend when she turns up beaten and pregnant; when Rollins is forced to take drastic action, an internal affairs investigation begins.

Episodes.Title: Law & Order: Special Victims Unit S14E16
Episodes.Description: A promising singer is beaten by her boyfriend, a famous hip-hop star, but she refuses to help ADA Barba build his case; the defendant and his attorney turn the case into a media circus.

Episodes.Title: Law & Order: Special Victims Unit S14E17
Episodes.Description: A woman claims that Brian Cassidy raped her while he was working under cover; when Cassidy and his lawyer utilize surprising defense methods, Detective Amaro is affected.

Episodes.Title: Law & Order: Special Victims Unit S14E18
Episodes.Description: A popular sports reporter accuses a cameraman of rape and stalking; when the victim learns she is pregnant as a result of the rape, the defense employs controversial tactics in hope of gaining favor with the jury.

Episodes.Title: Law & Order: Special Victims Unit S14E19
Episodes.Description: The SVU detectives investigate after a school nurse notices multiple injuries on a young girl; Detective Amaro tries to bond with his recently discovered son.

Episodes.Title: Law & Order: Special Victims Unit S14E20
Episodes.Description: As the SVU detectives investigate the alleged rape of a sorority pledge, drunken students, and conflicting accounts complicate matters.

Episodes.Title: Law & Order: Special Victims Unit S14E21
Episodes.Description: When a concert turns into a mob scene, a teenager is brutally assaulted; Detective Amaro ends up defending the prime suspect's reputation.

Episodes.Title: Law & Order: Special Victims Unit S14E22
Episodes.Description: When two sniper attacks on the NYPD link to Detective Tutuola's past as a narcotics officer, he reconnects with his former partner in hope of finding a motive.

Episodes.Title: Law & Order: Special Victims Unit S14E23
Episodes.Description: The investigation into how a comatose woman ended up in a river near the mayor's home reveals the victim's unexpected wild side.

Episodes.Title: Law & Order: Special Victims Unit S14E24
Episodes.Description: The detectives uncover a shocking theory as they work to learn the identity of a man Rollins arrested for exposing himself in the park.

Episodes.Title: Law & Order: Special Victims Unit S15E01
Episodes.Description: The SVU squad searches for Detective Benson and her abductor.

Episodes.Title: Law & Order: Special Victims Unit S15E02
Episodes.Description: When a young boy is abandoned, the squad discovers more victims waiting to be rescued.

Episodes.Title: Law & Order: Special Victims Unit S15E03
Episodes.Description: As a series of rapes on the Upper West Side puts the city on edge, a celebrity chef fears she is the next victim when someone follows her home; Detective Benson has a hard time overcoming her traumatic ordeal.

Episodes.Title: Law & Order: Special Victims Unit S15E04
Episodes.Description: When Officer Michael Groves ends up in a psych ward after leveling accusations at the 12th Precinct, Internal Affairs asks the team to help investigate.

Episodes.Title: Law & Order: Special Victims Unit S15E05
Episodes.Description: Investigation into the suspected rape of a woman Benson helped earlier leads to a cybermogul. The team bids farewell to Munch.

Episodes.Title: Law & Order: Special Victims Unit S15E06
Episodes.Description: ADA Barba finds that a friend -- with a connection to a mayoral candidate front runner -- is accused of rape.

Episodes.Title: Law & Order: Special Victims Unit S15E07
Episodes.Description: A four-year-old student makes claims of sexual abuse against a singing coach and popular TV personality.

Episodes.Title: Law & Order: Special Victims Unit S15E08
Episodes.Description: A military officer who was gang raped refuses to cooperate with the SVU for fear of damage to her reputation; Amaro asks his ex to help dig up information on the case.

Episodes.Title: Law & Order: Special Victims Unit S15E09
Episodes.Description: When Rollins tries to help a friend press rape charges against her lover, she finds herself thrust into the middle of the case.

Episodes.Title: Law & Order: Special Victims Unit S15E10
Episodes.Description: When Detective Benson faces Lewis in the courtroom, the stress causes setbacks in her recovery; Benson is forced to reveal secrets.

Episodes.Title: Law & Order: Special Victims Unit S15E11
Episodes.Description: When a suspect is gravely injured and the case becomes a public spectacle, Amaro's badge is on the line; Cragen surprises everyone with an announcement.

Episodes.Title: Law & Order: Special Victims Unit S15E12
Episodes.Description: When an underage runaway is found beaten and raped, the SVU team works with federal prosecutor Connie Rubirosa; ADA Barba suspects a cover-up when he fails to get the help he needs from Jersey law enforcement.

Episodes.Title: Law & Order: Special Victims Unit S15E13
Episodes.Description: Amaro suspects the boyfriend of a missing girl is involved with a gang; Benson becomes the SVU's new sergeant.

Episodes.Title: Law & Order: Special Victims Unit S15E14
Episodes.Description: The already frantic search for a missing diabetic boy becomes more urgent when he is spotted with a couple known for child endangerment and pornography.

Episodes.Title: Law & Order: Special Victims Unit S15E15
Episodes.Description:
Popular comedian Josh Galloway is faced with student protestors after a set at Tompkins Square University. Though Barba can't arrest him for speaking his mind, he charges the SVU to find proof that Galloway's actions reflect his words. Meanwhile, a detective from Chicago seeks help from the NYPD.

The crossover continues on Chicago P.D. S1E06 Conventions (II).

Episodes.Title: Law & Order: Special Victims Unit S15E16
Episodes.Description: Detective Rollins is contacted by a hometown friend when his son, a high school football star, goes missing in New York; Rollins seeks help with her escalating problems.

Episodes.Title: Law & Order: Special Victims Unit S15E17
Episodes.Description: When Rollins strikes a deal with the managers of a gambling club in order to protect her job, she ends up drawing the suspicion of Benson and Tutuola.

Episodes.Title: Law & Order: Special Victims Unit S15E18
Episodes.Description: A columnist who has been given access to the squad for a story declares a hate crime case a hoax, leaving the victim under media scrutiny and Benson fighting to get the case back on solid ground.

Episodes.Title: Law & Order: Special Victims Unit S15E19
Episodes.Description: After a single mom is arrested for leaving her young daughter alone for days, Sgt. Benson suspects the woman may have been abused in her own childhood.

Episodes.Title: Law & Order: Special Victims Unit S15E20
Episodes.Description: Benson is assigned a 24/7 security detail when William Lewis escapes from prison and starts killing again; Benson must decide how much she is willing to sacrifice to save a child's life.

Episodes.Title: Law & Order: Special Victims Unit S15E21
Episodes.Description: Olivia Benson is investigated by Internal Affairs after William Lewis' death; as pressure mounts, Olivia has to choose between her convictions and her badge.

Episodes.Title: Law & Order: Special Victims Unit S15E22
Episodes.Description: Benson and Murphy question a television producer when he is accused of molesting his daughter; Benson strives to discover the truth as accusations fly in the media.

Episodes.Title: Law & Order: Special Victims Unit S15E23
Episodes.Description: Taking an active approach to catching sex offenders, the team targets a photographer with a secret life whose fantasies may have crossed into reality.

Episodes.Title: Law & Order: Special Victims Unit S15E24
Episodes.Description: Amaro must face the consequence of his reckless behavior; when an online ad for escorts leads to the rape and robbery of tourists, Benson discovers she has a connection to one of the suspect's.

Episodes.Title: Law & Order: Special Victims Unit S16E01
Episodes.Description: Benson struggles to balance work and her new role of foster mother; when Amaro arrests a young prostitute with connections to Noah's mother, his undercover work sets off a dangerous chain of events.

Episodes.Title: Law & Order: Special Victims Unit S16E02
Episodes.Description: When a series of allegations are made against a superstar basketball player, Sgt. Benson and Detective Carisi do not agree on the authenticity of each woman's story; the investigation takes Rollins back to her former precinct.

Episodes.Title: Law & Order: Special Victims Unit S16E03
Episodes.Description: Amaro's by-the-book handling of a starlet's arrest gets him back on the SVU squad in time to investigate the actress's latest offense, statutory rape.

Episodes.Title: Law & Order: Special Victims Unit S16E04
Episodes.Description: The team tries to find a bike messenger -- who has kept a video diary of his troubles with women -- before he can commit another violent act; the new deputy chief calls Benson's leadership into question.

Episodes.Title: Law & Order: Special Victims Unit S16E05
Episodes.Description: A college student becomes a target after her work as an online porn star is discovered by her classmates.

Episodes.Title: Law & Order: Special Victims Unit S16E06
Episodes.Description: Three young girls' search for a mythical character leads to one of them becoming injured and the other two disappearing.

Episodes.Title: Law & Order: Special Victims Unit S16E07
Episodes.Description:
SVU and Chicago PD officer Erin Lindsay try to track down Lindsay's half-brother, who may be able to help take down a child pornography ring.

The crossover starts on Chicago Fire S03E07 Nobody Touches Anything (I). It continues on Chicago P.D. S02E07 They'll Have to Go Through Me (III).

Episodes.Title: Law & Order: Special Victims Unit S16E08
Episodes.Description: Sergeant Benson tries to help a domestic violence victim who stands by her man.

Episodes.Title: Law & Order: Special Victims Unit S16E09
Episodes.Description: A serial rapist strikes in several cities where the rape kit backlog stalls the investigation.

Episodes.Title: Law & Order: Special Victims Unit S16E10
Episodes.Description: When a professional relationship crosses the line, Detective Rollins must face her past to support another female officer.

Episodes.Title: Law & Order: Special Victims Unit S16E11
Episodes.Description: A teenager is sexually assaulted and left for dead in an alley after attending a movie star's party; Benson is suspicious when security footage from the party goes missing.

Episodes.Title: Law & Order: Special Victims Unit S16E12
Episodes.Description: When his father is arrested, Amaro must choose between his badge and his family’s honor.

Episodes.Title: Law & Order: Special Victims Unit S16E13
Episodes.Description: Two families are left to pick up the pieces of their lives when a rape case goes terribly wrong.

Episodes.Title: Law & Order: Special Victims Unit S16E14
Episodes.Description: A female videogame developer is harassed and threatened by a group of misogynistic cyber terrorists.
