Episodes.Description: The search for a missing witness leads Fin and Kat down a dangerous path. Chief McGrath puts pressure on Garland and Benson to get a conviction.

Episodes.Title: Law & Order: Special Victims Unit S23E03
Episodes.Description: Benson and Rollins must contend with the FBI and the Organized Crime bureau when a rape victim identifies a dangerous mobster as her assailant.

Episodes.Title: Law & Order: Special Victims Unit S23E04
Episodes.Description: The SVU searches for a serial rapist who preys on mothers with young children. Benson and Fin struggle under the tightened reins of Chief McGrath.

Episodes.Title: Law & Order: Special Victims Unit S23E05
Episodes.Description: The SVU faces the fury of social media fans when they arrest two popular influencer brothers.

Episodes.Title: Law & Order: Special Victims Unit S23E06
Episodes.Description: Amaro returns to ask the SVU for help in clearing a convicted man's name and brings a figure from Benson's past back into her life.

Episodes.Title: Law & Order: Special Victims Unit S23E07
Episodes.Description: When a teenage sex worker disappears, Rollins and Velasco find a key clue in a pile of neglected missing persons reports.

Episodes.Title: Law & Order: Special Victims Unit S23E08
Episodes.Description: Carisi asks the SVU for help with a murder investigation when one of the witnesses shows signs of abuse.

Episodes.Title: Law & Order: Special Victims Unit S23E09
Episodes.Description:
Carisi tries Richard Wheatley for the murder of Kathy Stabler. Benson finds herself at odds with a friend when Barba agrees to take the case.

The crossover continues on Law & Order: Organized Crime S02E09 The Christmas Episode (II).

Episodes.Title: Law & Order: Special Victims Unit S23E10
Episodes.Description: The SVU is called in to help investigate a wave of hate crimes on Christmas Eve. Rollins catches up with an old flame.

Episodes.Title: Law & Order: Special Victims Unit S23E11
Episodes.Description: A boy disappears after meeting up with an online gamer; Benson suspects her son is being bullied.

Episodes.Title: Law & Order: Special Victims Unit S23E12
Episodes.Description: When a popular fighter doesn't show up for the biggest bout of the year, Rollins and Velasco are drawn into a complicated web of secrets. McGrath confides in Benson.

Episodes.Title: Law & Order: Special Victims Unit S23E13
Episodes.Description: After a woman disappears, the squad notice similarities to a 20 year old DV case. Rollins and Carisi's relationship faces a challenge.

Episodes.Title: Law & Order: Special Victims Unit S23E14
Episodes.Description: Benson investigates allegations against a popular radio personality. Rollins goes undercover when a shocking confession leads to another crime.

Episodes.Title: Law & Order: Special Victims Unit S23E15
Episodes.Description: Carisi's niece helps a friend report a sexual assault. Benson investigates a college's secret society that preys on female students.

Episodes.Title: Law & Order: Special Victims Unit S23E16
Episodes.Description: The creator of a dating app is accused of using it to rape women. Velasco's experience as an SVU detective is put on trial.

Episodes.Title: Law & Order: Special Victims Unit S23E17
Episodes.Description: Velasco asks Benson for help finding three girls who were trafficked from his hometown to New York City.

Episodes.Title: Law & Order: Special Victims Unit S23E18
Episodes.Description: Rollins and Fin investigate an assault in Kentucky that has striking similarities to a victim found in Central Park. Benson receives intel that turns the case upside down.

Episodes.Title: Law & Order: Special Victims Unit S23E19
Episodes.Description: Garland asks Benson to reopen a missing persons case he worked as a rookie officer. A victim in one of Carisi's recent cases is arrested.

Episodes.Title: Law & Order: Special Victims Unit S23E20
Episodes.Description:
When a student’s school reports a girl missing, the squad must track down a trusted family friend for answers. Benson gets a Mother’s Day surprise.

The crossover continues on Law & Order: Organized Crime S02E20 Lost One (II).

Episodes.Title: Law & Order: Special Victims Unit S23E21
Episodes.Description: When the only evidence in a crime is a church confession, Carisi must find another way to prove his suspect guilty. Benson agrees to meet with Burton, who seeks to make amends for past transgressions.

Episodes.Title: Law & Order: Special Victims Unit S23E22
Episodes.Description: The SVU provides help and protection for a longtime domestic violence victim, but when she winds up at the defendant's table in court, Rollins surprises Carisi with a formidable opponent at trial.

Episodes.Title: Law & Order: Special Victims Unit S24E01
Episodes.Description:
A girl is shot and Cosgrove teams with Det. Jalen Shaw to track down her killer. Benson and Stabler assist and realize it's more than a typical homicide. McCoy and Price seek justice against an international crime ring.

The crossover begins on Law & Order: Organized Crime S03E01 Gimme Shelter (I). It continues on Law & Order S22E01 Gimme Shelter (III).

Episodes.Title: Law & Order: Special Victims Unit S24E02
Episodes.Description: A group of teens terrorizing tourists has the SVU squad working overtime; McGrath teams them up with the Bronx gang unit to track down a crucial lead.

Episodes.Title: Law & Order: Special Victims Unit S24E03
Episodes.Description: Benson tries to help a pop star in a volatile relationship; Rollins struggles with taking the stress of work home with her; Fin teaches a rookie a lesson in respecting fellow officers.

Episodes.Title: Law & Order: Special Victims Unit S24E04
Episodes.Description: A home invasion and kidnapping lead the SVU to a shocking discovery; Muncy tries to fit in with the squad.

Episodes.Title: Law & Order: Special Victims Unit S24E05
Episodes.Description: A young man asks the SVU for help when he suspects his boss is preying on his sister; Velasco tries to convince a reluctant witness to testify in court.

Episodes.Title: Law & Order: Special Victims Unit S24E06
Episodes.Description: Rollins investigates an assault by a masked man at an underground party. Benson uncovers a suspect who may be valuable as a witness.

Episodes.Title: Law & Order: Special Victims Unit S24E07
Episodes.Description: When the case against a popular sports star falls through, Benson digs into the suspect's past to uncover additional victims. Velasco is disappointed when he meets one of his heroes.

Episodes.Title: Law & Order: Special Victims Unit S24E08
Episodes.Description: The SVU hunts for a violent suspect who killed a detective's child. Rollins ponders a potential opportunity.

Episodes.Title: Law & Order: Special Victims Unit S24E09
Episodes.Description: Carisi and Rollins work together on an important arraignment. Benson tries to make Noah’s Christmas wish come true when a case falls in her lap.

Episodes.Title: Law & Order: Special Victims Unit S24E10
Episodes.Description: When Benson becomes the target of a ruthless gang leader, Capt. Duarte takes the case. Fin works with the Bronx SVU to help clear their case backlog. Sgt. Dixon offers to translate when a deaf student is raped.

Episodes.Title: Law & Order: Special Victims Unit S24E11
Episodes.Description: While Benson tries to help the gang member who attacked her, Duarte reveals a shocking piece of evidence in the case. Fin is tasked with hiring new detectives for the Bronx SVU.

Episodes.Title: Law & Order: Special Victims Unit S24E12
Episodes.Description: As Benson and Carisi put a vengeful crime boss on trial, Fin tries to help a woman who was drugged and left for dead. Velasco takes drastic action to get information from a witness.

Episodes.Title: Law & Order: Special Victims Unit S24E13
Episodes.Description: A car accident leads the detectives on a search for an ambulance driver assaulting his charges. Fin gives Det. Bruno a tour of Manhattan SVU.

Episodes.Title: Law & Order: Special Victims Unit S24E14
Episodes.Description: A recently released convict goes looking for his arresting officer, Fin Tutuola; Carisi tries to get an arrest warrant without a positive suspect ID.

Episodes.Title: Law & Order: Special Victims Unit S24E15
Episodes.Description: A man with dementia confesses to murder, but Benson and Carisi believe there's more to the case; when rumors swirl around the squad room, Fin presses Velasco for the truth.

Episodes.Title: Law & Order: Special Victims Unit S24E16
Episodes.Description: An internet dating site becomes the source of terror for a young widow. Muncy struggles with Velasco's absence.

Episodes.Title: Law & Order: Special Victims Unit S24E17
Episodes.Description: The search for a suspect who drugs women's drinks in crowded bars leads the SVU to Muncy's brother. Churlish makes a risky move to impress Benson.

Episodes.Title: Law & Order: Special Victims Unit S24E18
Episodes.Description: A construction tycoon interferes with an SVU investigation into her family. Carisi struggles to get an indictment when the complainant backs down.

Episodes.Title: Law & Order: Special Victims Unit S24E19
Episodes.Description: Carisi must tread carefully when Maxwell’s husband becomes a person of interest in an SVU investigation. Benson sends Velasco to take an old friend into custody.

Episodes.Title: Law & Order: Special Victims Unit S24E20
Episodes.Description: Benson tries to help a student after she’s assaulted on a field trip. Fin suspects a witness in the case may not be telling the whole truth.

Episodes.Title: Law & Order: Special Victims Unit S24E21
Episodes.Description:
Benson and Carisi are baffled when a series of assaults have the same M.O. but different DNA at each crime scene. Muncy believes Elias Olsen has struck again and is determined to prove it.

The crossover continues on Law & Order: Organized Crime S03E21 Shadowërk (II), Law & Order: Special Victims Unit S24E22 All Pain Is One Malady (III), and Law & Order: Organized Crime S03E22 With Many Names (IV).

Episodes.Title: Law & Order: Special Victims Unit S24E22
Episodes.Description:
Benson and Stabler combine forces on a global revenge-for-hire case. Fin and Bruno help a victim assaulted a second time. Jet's plan to hack the dark web backfires and puts the team in danger.

The crossover starts on Law & Order: Special Victims Unit S24E21 Bad Things (I) and Law & Order: Organized Crime S03E21 Shadowërk (II). It continues on Law & Order: Organized Crime S03E22 With Many Names (IV).

Episodes.Title: Law & Order: Special Victims Unit S25E01
Episodes.Description: As the squad celebrates Rollins and Carisi’s child, another child goes missing in broad daylight.

Episodes.Title: Law & Order: Special Victims Unit S25E02
Episodes.Description: As Benson teams up with the FBI on an unsolved case, Fin and Velasco investigate a flash mob robbery that lead to a sexual assault.

Episodes.Title: Law & Order: Special Victims Unit S25E03
Episodes.Description: The SVU helps a man come to terms with being victimized. Benson tries to support a victim's family when tragedy strikes twice.

Episodes.Title: Law & Order: Special Victims Unit S25E04
Episodes.Description: When Chief McGrath's daughter discloses a sexual assault, Benson must balance the intricacies of the investigation with McGrath's impulsive actions.

Episodes.Title: Law & Order: Special Victims Unit S25E05
Episodes.Description: A cryptic message sends SVU on a new track to find Maddie. Benson tries to help a federal agent when the case hits too close to home. Captain Curry tries to make amends with Fin.

Episodes.Title: Law & Order: Special Victims Unit S25E06
Episodes.Description: To identify a woman's attacker, the SVU must track down a mysterious suspect targeting tourists staying in hostels.

Episodes.Title: Law & Order: Special Victims Unit S25E07
Episodes.Description: When a woman turns her husband in for possessing child pornography, the case is complicated by a sudden death. Benson tries to reconnect with a victim she saved.

Episodes.Title: Law & Order: Special Victims Unit S25E08
Episodes.Description: A brutal assault in the street leads Carisi to pursue hate crime charges. Benson must support a homebound witness too scared to speak up.

Episodes.Title: Law & Order: Special Victims Unit S25E09
Episodes.Description: A teenager found unconscious in the park leads to a missing persons investigation. Benson must help Noah come to terms with the past when he questions the origins of his birth.

Episodes.Title: Law & Order: Special Victims Unit S25E10
Episodes.Description: The squad is on edge as Carisi waits for a verdict in Maddie's kidnapping case. Benson tries to help the Flynn family pick up the pieces of their broken life.

Episodes.Title: Law & Order: Special Victims Unit S25E11
Episodes.Description: A runaway bride calls the SVU for help on the day of her wedding. Rollins pitches in on her day off.

Episodes.Title: Law & Order: Special Victims Unit S25E12
Episodes.Description: Agent Sykes struggles to cope on the anniversary of her sister's disappearance. Benson suspects a cold case from Manhattan could help her get closure.

Episodes.Title: Law & Order: Special Victims Unit S25E13
Episodes.Description: The SVU searches for a pattern assailant before his crimes escalate to murder. Fin must contend with a suspect's aggrieved son. Carisi is pressured to close the case quickly to ease public concern.

Episodes.Title: Law & Order: Special Victims Unit S26E01
Episodes.Description: The SVU investigates a brutal attack on a group of law students. Benson hopes the discovery of a hidden camera will crack the case open. Carisi's best chance at conviction is catching the defendant in a lie.

Episodes.Title: Law & Order: Special Victims Unit S26E02
Episodes.Description: Devastating repressed memories come back to a woman when she finds an old notebook in her family home. Bringing charges in a decades-old crime proves even more difficult for Carisi when a powerful judge stalls the case.

Episodes.Title: Law & Order: Special Victims Unit S26E03
Episodes.Description: A couple's dinner party ends with a violent home invasion and assault by masked men. Sgt. Rollins suspects the crime is linked to her Intelligence investigation of an international gang of thieves.

Episodes.Title: Law & Order: Special Victims Unit S26E04
Episodes.Description: A romantic date ends with a teenager fighting for her life in the hospital. Carisi can't help bringing the case home with him as he envisions the dangers ahead for his growing daughters.

Episodes.Title: Law & Order: Special Victims Unit S26E05
Episodes.Description: When a TV reporter becomes the victim of sextortion that could ruin her career, Benson helps her take back control while Velasco goes undercover as a potential rich target.

Episodes.Title: Law & Order: Special Victims Unit S26E06
Episodes.Description: Agent Clay consults with Benson when a woman is found gravely injured at a remote campground and the suspect could be anywhere along the Eastern Seaboard. Bruno and Silva take a chance on an odd hunch to see if it becomes a lead.

Episodes.Title: Law & Order: Special Victims Unit S26E07
Episodes.Description: Bruno must get to the center of a victim's incomplete story to track down a serial rapist. Carisi is helpless to stop a crime he suspects is about to be committed.

Episodes.Title: Law & Order: Special Victims Unit S26E08
Episodes.Description: Carisi tries to protect two women taken hostage in a tense standoff between police and a violent thief. Benson and Rollins devise a risky plan to get everyone to safety.

Episodes.Title: Law & Order: Special Victims Unit S26E09
Episodes.Description: An abhorrent web of lies and betrayal is uncovered when a woman is confronted with video of a night she can't remember. Carisi struggles to move on from his ordeal when the suspect changes his plea.

Episodes.Title: Law & Order: Special Victims Unit S26E10
Episodes.Description: When a teen from a group home goes missing, the squad has only minutes to determine if he ran away or was abducted. Velasco suspects the system at large is to blame for letting children slip through the cracks.

Episodes.Title: Law & Order: Special Victims Unit S26E11
Episodes.Description: A young boy seeks help when his sister doesn't come home from work. Benson and Carisi suspect a woman's assault was prearranged by a third party.

Episodes.Title: Law & Order: Special Victims Unit S26E12
Episodes.Description: When a high school principal busts a student for sexting, the SVU uncovers a sinister case of distribution concerning hundreds of underage students. Silva pleads for leniency for a suspect she believes is innocent.

Episodes.Title: Law & Order: Special Victims Unit S26E13
Episodes.Description: Velasco teams up with a community security guard eager to prove his mettle to find a suspect in the assault of two teens.

Episodes.Title: Law & Order: Special Victims Unit S26E14
Episodes.Description: A Midwestern tourist is viciously attacked in Times Square. As the squad scours the area for clues, the victim takes the investigation into her own hands. A secret motive threatens to derail Carisi's case.

Episodes.Title: Law & Order: Special Victims Unit S26E15
Episodes.Description: A complicated case of sex and drug use divides the squad. Carisi must convince a jury to focus on the law and not the defendant's accusations.

Episodes.Title: Law & Order: Special Victims Unit S26E16
Episodes.Description: The doctor of a comatose woman calls SVU when he discovers his patient is pregnant. Benson must convince the family to reject magical thinking and look at the facts.

Episodes.Title: Law & Order: Special Victims Unit S26E17
Episodes.Description: Carisi attempts to put aside his role as prosecutor to serve as a witness in a trial. Benson tries to help a rape survivor struggling with her recovery.

Episodes.Title: Law & Order: Special Victims Unit S26E18
Episodes.Description: When a man is ruthlessly assaulted and burned, the SVU's investigation uncovers a decades-old secret. Bruno helps a young witness find the courage to come forward.

Episodes.Title: Law & Order: Special Victims Unit S26E19
Episodes.Description:
When the SVU and the 2-7 uncover a pattern of rape and murder targeting marginalized women, Carisi and ADA Price team up to charge the suspect with multiple crimes.

The crossover starts on Law & Order S24E19 Play with Fire (I).

Episodes.Title: Law & Order: Special Victims Unit S26E20
Episodes.Description: When a car with a young girl in the backseat is stolen, the SVU investigates whether it was a crime of opportunity or a targeted abduction.

Episodes.Title: Law & Order: Special Victims Unit S26E21
Episodes.Description: When an assault at gunpoint is witnessed through a neighboring window, the squad scrambles to locate the victim to confirm she's safe. A threat to extort the victim's family leads to a shocking suspect.

Episodes.Title: Law & Order: Special Victims Unit S26E22
Episodes.Description: Benson investigates a string of sexual assaults targeting local female psychiatrists. The squad celebrates a promotion.

Episodes.Title: Law & Order: Special Victims Unit S27E01
Episodes.Description: In the criminal justice system, sexually-based offenses are considered especially heinous. In New York City, the dedicated detectives who investigate these vicious felonies are members of an elite squad known as the Special Victims Unit. These are their stories.

Entries.Title: Butterfly
Entries.Description: David Jung, a Korean-American man who faked his death nine years ago, confronts his past when his daughter Rebecca, now working as an assassin for the private intelligence agency Caddis, is sent to kill him.

Episodes.Title: Butterfly S01E01
Episodes.Description: David Jung, a Korean-American man who faked his death nine years ago, confronts his past when his daughter Rebecca, now working as an assassin for the private intelligence agency Caddis, is sent to kill him.

Episodes.Title: Butterfly S01E02
Episodes.Description: David and Rebecca find themselves on the run from Caddis after a tense encounter at a police checkpoint. But their unexpected reunion is complicated by Rebecca's resentment over her father's abandonment.

Episodes.Title: Butterfly S01E03
Episodes.Description: Rebecca, David and his family escape to a safe house in the coastal city of Busan. Family tensions mount as Rebecca struggles with her father's new family. And a shocking revelation about David's past with Juno is revealed during a violent confrontation at a marina.

Episodes.Title: Butterfly S01E04
Episodes.Description: After abducting Oliver, David and Rebecca use the information they gather from him to devise a plan to go after Juno, taking them back to Seoul, where Gun and Caddis are waiting.

Episodes.Title: Butterfly S01E05
Episodes.Description: Juno interrogates Oliver and discovers he betrayed her while being held captive by David. Meanwhile, David and Rebecca carry out a PSYOP campaign against Juno, aimed at dividing her and Oliver and bringing down Caddis once and for all.

Episodes.Title: Butterfly S01E06
Episodes.Description: David pursues Rebecca after she's captured by Juno and Caddis operatives, leading to a high-speed chase and brutal ambush at an abandoned factory site.

Entries.Title: Squid Game
Entries.Description: Hoping to win easy money, a broke and desperate Gi-hun agrees to take part in an enigmatic game. Not long into the first round, unforeseen horrors unfold.

Episodes.Title: Squid Game S01E01
Episodes.Description: Hoping to win easy money, a broke and desperate Gi-hun agrees to take part in an enigmatic game. Not long into the first round, unforeseen horrors unfold.

Episodes.Title: Squid Game S01E02
Episodes.Description: Split on whether to continue or quit, the group holds a vote. But their realities in the outside world may prove to be just as unforgiving as the game.

Episodes.Title: Squid Game S01E03
Episodes.Description: A few players enter the next round — which promises equal doses of sweet and deadly — with hidden advantages. Meanwhile, Jun-ho sneaks his way inside.

Episodes.Title: Squid Game S01E04
Episodes.Description: As alliances form among the players, no one is safe in the dorm after lights-out. The third game challenges Gi-hun's team to think strategically.

Episodes.Title: Squid Game S01E05
Episodes.Description: Gi-hun and his team take turns keeping guard through the night. The masked men encounter trouble with their co-conspirators.

Episodes.Title: Squid Game S01E06
Episodes.Description: Players pair off for the fourth game. Gi-hun grapples with a moral dilemma, Sang-woo chooses self-preservation and Sae-byeok shares her untold story.

Episodes.Title: Squid Game S01E07
Episodes.Description: The Masked Leader welcomes VIP guests to the facility for a front-row viewing of the show. In the fifth game, some players crack under pressure.

Episodes.Title: Squid Game S01E08
Episodes.Description: Ahead of the last round, distrust and disgust run deep among the finalists. Jun-ho makes a getaway, determined to expose the game's dirty secrets.

Episodes.Title: Squid Game S01E09
Episodes.Description: The final round presents another cruel test — but this time, how it ends depends on just one player. The game's creator steps out of the shadows.

Episodes.Title: Squid Game S02E01
Episodes.Description: A vengeful Gi-hun makes a U-turn at the airport. Later, in his hideout, he intensifies his search for the elusive recruiter who is seeking new players.

Episodes.Title: Squid Game S02E02
Episodes.Description: Gi-hun finally gets hold of an invitation, marked for Halloween day. In a tense moment facing Jun-ho, they reveal their truths to each other.

Episodes.Title: Squid Game S02E03
Episodes.Description: New players gather for a chance to win 45.6 billion won. After an intense first round, the survivors' fates hang in the balance — down to one final vote.

Episodes.Title: Squid Game S02E04
Episodes.Description: The players prepare for the next game: a six-legged pentathlon, where each team member must clear a mini-game to survive — or face collective elimination.

Episodes.Title: Squid Game S02E05
Episodes.Description: Kang No-eul earns enemies for her unruly actions. Nerves fray to the breaking point as the remaining players vote on whether to move to the next round.

Episodes.Title: Squid Game S02E06
Episodes.Description: Jun-ho and his team prepare to infiltrate a suspicious island. As monetary stakes and tensions rise, players split into two opposing factions.

Episodes.Title: Squid Game S02E07
Episodes.Description: The remaining players strategize on how to survive the night. Gi-hun proposes a risky plan — but he will need trustworthy allies to carry it out.

Episodes.Title: Squid Game S03E01
Episodes.Description: No-eul infiltrates a dangerous operation with a risky plan. A new game is announced: hide-and-seek, where one group holds a key and the other a knife.

Episodes.Title: Squid Game S03E02
Episodes.Description: The games resume, and Gi-hun fixates on confronting Kang Dae-ho. Meanwhile, Kim Jun-hee faces a sudden crisis that pushes her willpower to its limits.

Episodes.Title: Squid Game S03E03
Episodes.Description: Jun-ho's team gets close to finding the island. Jang Geum-ja makes a desperate plea to Gi-hun to help Jun-hee. The VIPs discuss a cruel proposal.

Episodes.Title: Squid Game S03E04
Episodes.Description: Even as Gi-hun supports Jun-hee amid rising tensions, she must make a pivotal decision. Before the final game, the Front Man gives Gi-hun an ultimatum.

Episodes.Title: Squid Game S03E05
Episodes.Description: No-eul tries to gain the upper hand in negotiations, but her plans backfire. Gi-hun faces a moral crossroads, testing his limits — how far will he go?

Episodes.Title: Squid Game S03E06
Episodes.Description: As Jun-ho races to reach the island, tensions peak in the final round. The last players face an impossible situation in the closing minutes of the game.

Entries.Title: The Rookie
Entries.Description: Starting over isn't easy, especially for small-town guy John Nolan who, after a life-altering incident, is pursuing his dream of being a police officer. As the force's oldest rookie, he’s met with skepticism from some higher-ups who see him as just a walking midlife crisis. Throw in a workplace romance, a hostage situation, and some tough love from their new training officers, and the latest Los Angeles police rookie class has an uphill battle ahead of them.

Episodes.Title: The Rookie S01E01
Episodes.Description: Starting over isn't easy, especially for small-town guy John Nolan who, after a life-altering incident, is pursuing his dream of being a police officer. As the force's oldest rookie, he’s met with skepticism from some higher-ups who see him as just a walking midlife crisis. Throw in a workplace romance, a hostage situation, and some tough love from their new training officers, and the latest Los Angeles police rookie class has an uphill battle ahead of them.

Episodes.Title: The Rookie S01E02
Episodes.Description: Talia forces Nolan to confront his personal moral instincts in order to be a good cop after he encounters a kidnapping victim. Lucy is temporarily placed with a new training officer who tests her patience. Jackson must confront his failures head-on if he wants to be an officer.

Episodes.Title: The Rookie S01E03
Episodes.Description: After Nolan and Talia lose control of a crime scene, they begin to debate whether people are fundamentally good or bad and what that means for a police officer. Lucy is concerned Tim is enabling his wife’s destructive behavior and not taking care of himself.

Episodes.Title: The Rookie S01E04
Episodes.Description: The rookies are temporarily paired with new training officers, and Nolan is paired with Lopez. When Nolan and Lopez track down an escaped criminal, they discover a little kindness goes a long way. Jackson is forced to face his fears when he is partnered with Officer Bradford. Chen and Nolan must face a hard truth.

Episodes.Title: The Rookie S01E05
Episodes.Description: Nolan, the rookies and their training officers get involved in a competition that pits them against each other. Chen notices Bradford is obsessed with winning at all costs.

Episodes.Title: The Rookie S01E06
Episodes.Description: Nolan and the team must help capture a cop and his former mentor from the academy after he becomes a fugitive following an assault. Bradford needs Chen to learn to predict the moves of criminals in order to capture them.

Episodes.Title: The Rookie S01E07
Episodes.Description: Grey informs Nolan and Bishop that they are going to have a movie director as a ride-along during their patrol after a fun afternoon granting the wish of a Make-a-Wish kid as an honorary police officer. Bradford is tested once again after he learns that his wife has been arrested for drug possession.

Episodes.Title: The Rookie S01E08
Episodes.Description: Nolan and Bishop respond to a silent alarm call at a local convenience store where two men are attempting to rob the place. Bishop helps coordinate a drug bust that hits a little too close to home for Bradford.

Episodes.Title: The Rookie S01E09
Episodes.Description: Officer Bradford’s wife, Isabel, is found shot but alive and he vows to track down the man responsible. Meanwhile, Officer Nolan must protect his home and the truth after a home invasion attack.

Episodes.Title: The Rookie S01E10
Episodes.Description: On Captain Andersen’s orders, Officer Nolan and Sergeant Grey are paired up for the day on patrol. Additionally, Nolan’s son and Grey’s daughter visit their dads on the job and see them in action. Meanwhile, Officer Chen is paired up with Captain Andersen, and Officer Bradford tells Chen to protect her at all costs.

Episodes.Title: The Rookie S01E11
Episodes.Description: An unscheduled visit by the vice president of the United States puts the station on high alert. The secret service tasks Officer Nolan and Officer Bishop with checking out a possible threat to the vice president while the rest of the team try to keep the streets clear and safe for his visit.

Episodes.Title: The Rookie S01E12
Episodes.Description: The most dangerous day of the year – Valentine’s Day – has the team on high alert, and Officer Nolan invites everyone over for a party now that he is single.

Episodes.Title: The Rookie S01E13
Episodes.Description: The rookies become the prime suspects after it is discovered a large sum of money used in a drug bust has gone missing.

Episodes.Title: The Rookie S01E14
Episodes.Description: The rookies are really put to the test when their training officers accompany them out of uniform for Plain Clothes Day, which forces them to make all the decisions while on patrol. Meanwhile, Officer Nolan tries to prove he has been progressing faster than the other rookies to justify his desire of becoming a detective within five years.

Episodes.Title: The Rookie S01E15
Episodes.Description: When a prison bus crashes, all units must respond as some inmates face severe injuries while others seek an opportunity to flee. In the wake of the accident, Officer Nolan tries to impress an FBI hostage negotiator while tracking down an escaped convict.

Episodes.Title: The Rookie S01E16
Episodes.Description: Officer Nolan gets a lesson in respect after his arrest of a gang member leads to a free-for-all on his life. Meanwhile, Officer Chen and Officer Bradford pull over Mario Lopez, who thinks he can talk his way out of a traffic violation.

Episodes.Title: The Rookie S01E17
Episodes.Description: A massive earthquake rocks the city and throws everyone’s patrols and its citizens into chaos. Meanwhile, agent Russo recommends Officer Nolan for a protective detail of Brad Hayes, a man whose dealings have put a target on his head.

Episodes.Title: The Rookie S01E18
Episodes.Description: When one of their colleagues is arrested by Internal Affairs for lying on the witness stand, it leads to the release of three felons whose cases he worked on and the team being asked to check in on them now that they are free. Meanwhile, Officer Nolan finds out he is being sued by a man who claims he used excessive force which led to an injury.

Episodes.Title: The Rookie S01E19
Episodes.Description: Sergeant Gray informs the rookies that they must track down a specific set of crimes in a 48-hour period in order to qualify for their final exam. Meanwhile, Officer Nolan and Officer Bishop answer a silent alarm call at will.i.am’s house.

Episodes.Title: The Rookie S01E20
Episodes.Description: As the rookies prepare for a big exam to see who moves on to the next stage of training, Officer Nolan and Officer Bishop are called to the scene of a murder and learn that the victim may be tied to a potential terrorist attack on the city of Los Angeles.

Episodes.Title: The Rookie S02E01
Episodes.Description: Danger is ever-present as the officers of the Mid-Wilshire precinct grapple with the aftermath of a plotted attack on the city of Los Angeles, leaving Officer Bradford fighting for his life.

Episodes.Title: The Rookie S02E02
Episodes.Description: Nolan teams up with new night detective Nick Armstrong for a murder investigation case that results in an unexpected reunion with a former love interest. Officer Bradford reluctantly accepts help from Officer Chen as he prepares for his sergeant exam, and Officer West pursues an unconventional move after finding himself in need of a new home.

Episodes.Title: The Rookie S02E03
Episodes.Description: Officer Nolan navigates building tension in his relationship with Jessica and a developing rapport with Grace while working a high-stakes criminal case involving an undercover homeland security agent. Meanwhile, Officer Chen meddles with Officer Bradford’s love life, and Officer Lopez learns some surprising news about Wesley.

Episodes.Title: The Rookie S02E04
Episodes.Description: Officer Nolan gets off to a rocky start after being introduced to his new training officer, Nyla Harper, who has an unconventional approach to police work after her stint as an undercover detective. Meanwhile, Officer Bradford struggles to think of an appropriate birthday gift for Rachel, and Officer Lopez finds herself navigating a case that triggers a personal memory.

Episodes.Title: The Rookie S02E05
Episodes.Description: As part of their second phase of training, the rookies are asked to develop their first confidential informants. Officer Nolan soon discovers that no two informants are the same and struggles with his newest task. Meanwhile, Officer Chen’s mother complicates her home life when she comes to stay with her.

Episodes.Title: The Rookie S02E06
Episodes.Description: An emergency alert of an impending missile attack sends Los Angeles into chaos and uncertainty, while the officers each try to keep the peace and deal with their own disasters.

Episodes.Title: The Rookie S02E07
Episodes.Description: John and Jessica’s relationship gets a lot more complicated after she delivers some surprising news. Meanwhile, Officer Bradford and Office West are assigned a community policing project helping out the Watts Rams as volunteer coaches at their fall clinic, along with Rams players Eric Weddle and Robert Woods.

Episodes.Title: The Rookie S02E08
Episodes.Description: Officer Nolan kicks off his birthday by babysitting a crime scene at a law office. Meanwhile, Officer Bradford and Officer West are set to receive special awards, and Sgt. Grey rides patrol with Officer Harper after she requests an early annual evaluation.

Episodes.Title: The Rookie S02E09
Episodes.Description: Officer Nolan’s trust is tested when he tries to help the previous owner of his home reconnect with his family. Meanwhile, Officer Harper has finally earned an overnight visit with her daughter that is put into jeopardy when her past undercover life resurfaces again.

Episodes.Title: The Rookie S02E10
Episodes.Description: Officer Nolan and team are charged with escorting a notorious female serial killer to the graves of her previously unrecovered victims. However, when they arrive, they unearth even more than they expected. Meanwhile, Officer Chen meets a seemingly perfect man who sparks her interest, and Officer Lopez worries about Wesley as his PTSD continues to increase.

Episodes.Title: The Rookie S02E11
Episodes.Description: Officer Nolan and the entire team are in a desperate search to rescue Officer Chen after her abduction and must attempt to get Rosalind to help them in their search. Meanwhile, after Officer Lopez discovers Wesley unconscious from a dangerous cocktail of alcohol and pills, she is forced to keep him close by.

Episodes.Title: The Rookie S02E12
Episodes.Description: Nolan takes his son’s fiancé, Abigail, on a ride-along after she shows interest in becoming a police officer. Meanwhile, Jackson’s relationship is becoming complicated at work.

Episodes.Title: The Rookie S02E13
Episodes.Description: Nolan is given some life-changing news and invites Grace over for a homecooked meal in his newly remodeled kitchen. Meanwhile, each unit is tasked with following up on dormant cases in the hopes they can uncover new leads.

Episodes.Title: The Rookie S02E14
Episodes.Description: Officers Nolan and Harper investigate a murder which may have national security implications, while Officer Bradford must confront his past when he crosses paths with a homeless veteran.

Episodes.Title: The Rookie S02E15
Episodes.Description: Officer Nolan is having a particularly bad day after learning his identity has been stolen and could jeopardize his position as an officer. Meanwhile, Sgt. Grey must confront his past and testify at the parole hearing of the man who shot Grey and murdered his partner.

Episodes.Title: The Rookie S02E16
Episodes.Description: Officers Chen and Bradford respond to a call at the Los Angeles auditions of “American Idol,” and Officer Chen ends up facing Ryan Seacrest and the judges. Meanwhile, Chen befriends a reporter whose motives are not clear.

Episodes.Title: The Rookie S02E17
Episodes.Description: Officer Nolan’s relationship with his first confidential informant is tested when he discovers her back on the street dealing drugs. Meanwhile, Lucy’s fear of dating following her abduction and her intrusion into Jackson’s relationship is beginning to threaten their friendship.

Episodes.Title: The Rookie S02E18
Episodes.Description: Officers Nolan and Harper are tasked with escorting four juvenile offenders to a Scared Straight program at a correctional facility that quickly becomes a riotous situation. Meanwhile, Nolan is uncertain about his relationship with Grace after she fails to introduce him to her ex-husband.

Episodes.Title: The Rookie S02E19
Episodes.Description: Their rookie year is coming to an end and officers Nolan, Chen and West are about to be squeezed harder than ever before as their training officers evaluate whether they are truly ready for the job. Meanwhile, after one of their rookie classmates is involved in a shooting, the team uncovers some unsettling evidence .

Episodes.Title: The Rookie S02E20
Episodes.Description: Nolan's discovery goes much deeper than he expected and could put his life and career in jeopardy.

Episodes.Title: The Rookie S03E01
Episodes.Description: Nearing the end of his training, Nolan now faces his biggest challenge as a police officer yet when he must come to terms with the choices he has made in pursuit of the truth.

Episodes.Title: The Rookie S03E02
Episodes.Description: Officer John Nolan and Officer Nyla Harper are assigned to a community policing center to help rebuild their station’s reputation in the community. Nolan is determined to make a positive impact but Nyla has her doubts.

Episodes.Title: The Rookie S03E03
Episodes.Description: Officer John Nolan's mom makes an unannounced visit that complicates his life, and Sergeant Grey considers retiring.

Episodes.Title: The Rookie S03E04
Episodes.Description: Officer Jackson West’s relationship with his new training officer, Stanton, has escalated and he begins to work with Sergeant Grey to find a solution.

Episodes.Title: The Rookie S03E05
Episodes.Description: Officer Nolan is taken hostage by a man with nothing to lose while the station goes on lockdown and races to identify the suspect before time runs out. Meanwhile, Officer Jackson and his training officer, Officer Doug Stanton, reach a tipping point in their relationship that could end Jackson’s career.

Episodes.Title: The Rookie S03E06
Episodes.Description: Officer Nolan’s decision to return to school in order to become a training officer is proving to be much harder than he expected. Meanwhile, Officer Chen considers going into undercover work after getting a taste of the job when Harper’s former colleague needs help.

Episodes.Title: The Rookie S03E07
Episodes.Description: The team gets the true crime docuseries treatment when they analyze a recent case featuring a former child actor whose adult life has garnered him a cult following.

Episodes.Title: The Rookie S03E08
Episodes.Description: Officer Nolan, Officer Harper and Detective Lopez are assigned to the kidnapping of the son of a criminal court judge who has a long list of enemies who could possibly be involved.

Episodes.Title: The Rookie S03E09
Episodes.Description: An Amber Alert sends the team on a race against time to find a newborn infant who was stolen from a local hospital. Meanwhile, Officers Jackson and Chen work their last shift as rookies as Officer Nolan continues on for 30 more days.

Episodes.Title: The Rookie S03E10
Episodes.Description: Harper and Nolan respond to a bank robbery in progress and realize the motives of the thief run much deeper than just needing money. Jackson and Chen’s first day riding without training officers isn’t what they thought it would be.

Episodes.Title: The Rookie S03E11
Episodes.Description: When professor Fiona Ryan’s car window is smashed following a series of mysterious notes, Nolan volunteers to guard her house overnight. Lucy notices that Tim is being much nicer to his new boot than he was with her and she does not like it.

Episodes.Title: The Rookie S03E12
Episodes.Description: After rushing his son, Henry, to the hospital following his collapse, Nolan is reunited with his ex-wife, Sarah, and they must come together to help their son. Meanwhile, Detective Lopez discovers “La Fiera” is in the same hospital and wants to find out exactly why.

Episodes.Title: The Rookie S03E13
Episodes.Description: Officers Nolan and Bradford hope they can de-escalate a drug war before any innocent lives are lost. Meanwhile, Officer Harper hopes she can get Officer Chen ready to go undercover.

Episodes.Title: The Rookie S03E14
Episodes.Description: Officer Nolan mildly injures himself while chasing down a shoplifter and the local DA wants to charge the suspect with assault despite Nolan's wishes. Meanwhile, Lucy goes undercover, Lopez' wedding venue is seized by the FBI and Nolan meets his new neighbor.

Episodes.Title: The Rookie S04E01
Episodes.Description: Officer Nolan and the entire team race against the clock to locate Lopez after she is kidnapped on her wedding day, not only to save her life but her unborn child’s.

Episodes.Title: The Rookie S04E02
Episodes.Description: Officer Nolan and Officer Chen’s run-in with an infamous thief tips them off to a potentially big heist surrounding the Getty’s big gala event. Meanwhile, Nolan works up the courage to ask Bailey out on a date.

Episodes.Title: The Rookie S04E03
Episodes.Description: Officer Nolan and officer Chen report to a structure fire and suspect that there is more to the situation than meets the eye. Meanwhile, after witnessing a sniper shooting, the team searches for the shooter and discovers that the perpetrator has a connection to one of their own.

Episodes.Title: The Rookie S04E04
Episodes.Description: Officer Nolan and Officer Chen search for a missing person who may have international ties that puts everyone’s lives in danger. Meanwhile, Harper continues the search for a serial arsonist after responding to a report of an injured cyclist, and Wesley must overcome an impossible task.

Episodes.Title: The Rookie S04E05
Episodes.Description: When a new designer drug hits LA streets, it turns users into “zombies,” and Officer Nolan and the team have a Halloween they won’t soon forget. Back at home, Lucy questions whether her apartment building might be haunted.

Episodes.Title: The Rookie S04E06
Episodes.Description: Officer Nolan and team are on a hunt to retrieve a buried stash of gold before any treasure seekers get hurt. Meanwhile, Bradford is tasked with encouraging the oldest cop at the station to retire and invites him to ride with him.

Episodes.Title: The Rookie S04E07
Episodes.Description: In the aftermath of Fred’s house explosion, Officer Nolan and Bailey discover there’s more to Fred’s death than meets the eye. Meanwhile, Officer Chen and Officer Bradford demand a treasure hunt rematch and enlist Sgt. Grey to help set the terms to a new bet, all while they arrest a series of wealthy female criminals. Elsewhere, Wesley struggles to keep it together under the pressure of his debt to Elijah.

Episodes.Title: The Rookie S04E08
Episodes.Description: The team goes on a city-wide hunt for an individual who is threatening a mass casualty event. Meanwhile, Tim’s sister Genny shows up unannounced with some surprising news, and Lopez continues her inner struggle over Wesley’s deal with Elijah and tries to come up with a plan to get them out of it.

Episodes.Title: The Rookie S04E09
Episodes.Description: Desperate to break free from his connection to Elijah, Wesley tries to plant a listening device in his office to incriminate him; Officer Bradford and his sister, Genny, learn an unsettling truth about their father.

Episodes.Title: The Rookie S04E10
Episodes.Description: Now that John Nolan knows about Bailey’s past, he must decide if they still have a future. Meanwhile, when a plane crashes in the middle of the city the team races to find out why.

Episodes.Title: The Rookie S04E11
Episodes.Description: The team must rely on a criminal for his expertise to help take down an even bigger threat. Meanwhile, Officers Chen and Bradford investigate the murder of an unhoused teenager who used to be friends with Tamara.

Episodes.Title: The Rookie S04E12
Episodes.Description: The team responds to the report of a severed hand washing up on the beach and are on the hunt to find its owner. Meanwhile, Tim attempts to prove he isn’t a control freak to Lucy and invites her on a double date with him and Ashley.

Episodes.Title: The Rookie S04E13
Episodes.Description: Officers John Nolan and Lucy Chen must fulfill three quests if they want to get a stolen police helicopter back safely from a teenage thief. Meanwhile, Detective Nyla Harper and Officer Aaron Thorsen must guard a convicted cop killer in the hospital following a prison riot.

Episodes.Title: The Rookie S04E14
Episodes.Description: Officer Nolan and Detective Harper help Skip Tracer Randy on his first bounty hunter case. Meanwhile, Officer Chen and Sergeant Bradford are on the hunt for a perpetrator on a citywide crime spree.

Episodes.Title: The Rookie S04E15
Episodes.Description: Officer Harper puts Officer Aaron through “Plain Clothes Day,” but the exercise is interrupted by an unsuspected visitor. After two witnesses for an upcoming grand jury case are murdered, the team must track down the killers before it’s too late.

Episodes.Title: The Rookie S04E16
Episodes.Description: Desperate to reset the way the world sees him, Officer Thorsen reluctantly decides to be a part of a reality show to help rebrand his image, only to be thrust back into yet another deadly situation. With cameras rolling, the show’s producer is found murdered and the team must investigate before Aaron is made suspect number one.

Episodes.Title: The Rookie S04E17
Episodes.Description: Officer John Nolan and the team feel they must negotiate with a distraught man who is holding a hospital hostage to ensure his wife receives a lifesaving surgery.

Episodes.Title: The Rookie S04E18
Episodes.Description: After the robbery of a train filled with valuable auction items turns deadly, the team is called to investigate. Meanwhile, Officer Chen has doubts about being Sergeant Bradford’s aide and is upset when he doesn’t give her the recognition she deserves. Elsewhere, Officer Harper takes matters into her own hands and makes a life-changing decision about her personal life.

Episodes.Title: The Rookie S04E19
Episodes.Description: Officer Nolan and the LA division of the FBI enlist the help of FBI trainee Simone Clark when one of her former students is suspected of terrorism following an explosion at a local power station.

Episodes.Title: The Rookie S04E20
Episodes.Description: The team alongside the LA Division of the FBI are in a race to stop bombs that have been scattered throughout the city by a suspected terrorist. Meanwhile, the joint task force is suspicious of the CIA’s involvement in the situation.

Episodes.Title: The Rookie S04E21
Episodes.Description: Sergeant Grey supports Officer Nolan’s desire to become a training officer and offers to ride with him for the day to get him ready. Meanwhile, Tim and Lucy must manage expectations in their respective relationships as they decide on their plans for Mother’s Day and a romantic vacation.

Episodes.Title: The Rookie S04E22
Episodes.Description: Officer John Nolan is forced to spend a week in solitary confinement in a quiet border town with a young local officer who is in need of some training. Meanwhile, Sergeant Bradford and Officer Chen discover that looks are deceiving and go undercover together in a possible drug trafficking case.

Episodes.Title: The Rookie S05E01
Episodes.Description: Officer John Nolan is once again face-to-face with serial killer Rosalind, and she wants him to know she's not done with him yet. Meanwhile, officers Bradford and Chen work undercover with Detective Lopez and the Las Vegas Police Department to arrest leaders of a major criminal enterprise.

Episodes.Title: The Rookie S05E02
Episodes.Description: Officer John Nolan is moving closer to his new role as a training officer. In preparation, he is tasked with overseeing Officer Aaron Thorson and must uncover the truth about another officer’s suicide. Meanwhile, Lucy’s successful undercover assignment earns her an invitation for specialized training in Sacramento and she must decide if this is the path she wants to take.

Episodes.Title: The Rookie S05E03
Episodes.Description: Officer John Nolan is assigned his first rookie, Officer Celina Juarez, whose unconventional approach to police work poses a unique challenge for him.

Episodes.Title: The Rookie S05E04
Episodes.Description:
Rosalind returns with a vengeance and Bailey’s life is left hanging in the balance. With a ticking clock, the LAPD and the FBI join forces, and Officer John Nolan is forced to make a deadly decision after a harrowing ultimatum.

The crossover continues on The Rookie: Feds S01E04 To Die For (II).

Episodes.Title: The Rookie S05E05
Episodes.Description: Officer John Nolan and Officer Celina Juarez are on the hunt for a fugitive after a car incident goes awry. Meanwhile, a past injury comes to haunt Tim and Lucy comes through during his time in need in more ways than one.

Episodes.Title: The Rookie S05E06
Episodes.Description: Officer John Nolan and a sleep-deprived Celina investigate a cash deposit linked to an old DEA case. Meanwhile, Wesley grows increasingly concerned about his deposition and is shocked when he realizes Elijah’s attorney is a familiar face from his past.

Episodes.Title: The Rookie S05E07
Episodes.Description: Officer John Nolan and Celina witness a shooting, realize the victim was already dead, and investigate further. Back at home, Bailey has been feeling off-center ever since the proposal, leaving Nolan to wonder what he can do to make her feel more comfortable. Elsewhere, Lopez and Harper enlist Lucy’s help to investigate the gang-related murder of a local shopkeeper.

Episodes.Title: The Rookie S05E08
Episodes.Description: Officers John Nolan and Celina Juarez are in a race against time to stop the source of an explosive rampage.

Episodes.Title: The Rookie S05E09
Episodes.Description: Officer John Nolan and the team investigate the unexpected death of a suspect in police custody. Their search also uncovers a very delicate loose end that could jeopardize Officer Celina Juarez's career. Meanwhile, Sergeant Grey and his wife, Luna, go to New York to visit their daughter, Dominique, only to realize she never made it home from the night before.

Episodes.Title: The Rookie S05E10
Episodes.Description:
Detective Nyla Harper and James find themselves in the middle of a bank robbery which leads the entire team on a citywide manhunt. Meanwhile, Tim and Lucy finally go on their first date, but it does have a few complications.

The crossover continues on The Rookie: Feds S01E10 The Silent Prisoner (II).

Episodes.Title: The Rookie S05E11
Episodes.Description: The search for a missing boy leads the team into the middle of a dangerous drug war between two rival gangs.

Episodes.Title: The Rookie S05E12
Episodes.Description: Nolan and Celina must stand guard at a hospital after a dangerous prisoner needs surgery. Aaron, Lopez and Harper look into a string of robberies. Tim and Lucy consider how their secret relationship will affect their work. Lopez gets unexpected news.

Episodes.Title: The Rookie S05E13
Episodes.Description: In the midst of a heatwave and a citywide blackout, Officer John Nolan and Aaron follow increasingly large leads after they discover criminals hiding at the station. While on duty, Officer Chen makes an alarming discovery after being called to a scene where a pungent smell has wreaked havoc. Meanwhile, Lucy and Harper scheme to get Tim out of his new job and into a more exciting position.

Episodes.Title: The Rookie S05E14
Episodes.Description: Officer John Nolan and Bailey are on the hunt for a mystery gunman after a shooting hits a little too close to home. Meanwhile, Aaron struggles to live within his means and joins Lucy to help Tamara when the mother of a child she babysits goes missing. Elsewhere, Wesley suspects that a judge is taking bribes after he excludes valuable eyewitness testimony from a case.

Episodes.Title: The Rookie S05E15
Episodes.Description: With help from the FBI, Detective Lopez puts everything on the line to help Elijah Stone take down a gang leader in exchange for her safety. Meanwhile, Nolan and Bailey must deal with the secrets and shady dealings his late mother left behind.

Episodes.Title: The Rookie S05E16
Episodes.Description: The team must stop a militia from detonating a highly combustible truck in their possession. Meanwhile, Officers Nolan, Thorson, Juarez and Detective Harper search for three men who may have been exposed to Ebola and detain them for quarantine.

Episodes.Title: The Rookie S05E17
Episodes.Description:
Now that Elijah and Abril have become allies, the team must rely on Monica, Elijah’s lawyer, to uncover their plans. Meanwhile, Officers Nolan and Juarez reopen her sister’s case and discover a discrepancy that leads them on a new trail.

The crossover continues on The Rookie: Feds S01E17 Payback (II).

Episodes.Title: The Rookie S05E18
Episodes.Description: When Dim goes missing, Officer Chen and Sergeant Bradford, along with the CIA, set out to find him and enlist the help of Juicy.

Episodes.Title: The Rookie S05E19
Episodes.Description: The team investigates a pattern of kidnappings which leads them to a discovery that hits close to home with one of their own. Meanwhile, Lucy and Tim’s relationship is put to the test as they begin to feel the hard hours of their jobs.

Episodes.Title: The Rookie S05E20
Episodes.Description: Officer Tim Bradford’s ex-wife returns and asks the team to help her save someone from her undercover past. Isabel’s return also creates additional pressure in Lucy and Tim’s relationship as they assist in the search.

Episodes.Title: The Rookie S05E21
Episodes.Description:
Officer Lucy Chen goes undercover to infiltrate an illegal firearm operation, and Detective Harper and Officer John Nolan work together to solve a mystery involving severed limbs found around the city.

The crossover continues on The Rookie: Feds S01E21 Bloodline (II).

Episodes.Title: The Rookie S05E22
Episodes.Description: After one of their own is shot, the team suffers a series of close calls and realizes their division may be a target for a group of masked assailants.

Episodes.Title: The Rookie S06E01
Episodes.Description: In the aftermath of the assaults in the explosive season five finale, the team must now try to understand why they were targeted and if there is a bigger plan in place. Meanwhile, Nolan must survive his last shift before his wedding to Bailey.

Episodes.Title: The Rookie S06E02
Episodes.Description: The team comes together to celebrate John and Bailey’s wedding; meanwhile, Celina discovers a discrepancy in her case, leading to a new discovery. Elsewhere, Lucy and Tim’s relationship is put to the test.

Episodes.Title: The Rookie S06E03
Episodes.Description: Nolan and Bailey’s honeymoon is more of a nightmare than a dream when it turns into an active crime scene. Meanwhile, Tim and Celina partner up and must uncover the identity of John Doe.

Episodes.Title: The Rookie S06E04
Episodes.Description: It's Officer Aaron Thorsen's first day back since the assault, and he's tasked with a series of high-stress cases to determine whether he's ready to work. Elsewhere, the team investigates a homicide case with a potential tie to the pentagram killer.

Episodes.Title: The Rookie S06E05
Episodes.Description: When a toddler is found at the scene of a crime, John and Bailey must decide whether to let the child go to a shelter for the night or care for her themselves. Meanwhile, when someone from his past returns, Tim disappears and leaves Lucy in the dark.

Episodes.Title: The Rookie S06E06
Episodes.Description: Following their time as foster parents, Bailey has decided she wants to have a baby and forces John to reconsider their decision to not have children. Meanwhile, John and Celina discover a prison escapee whom they fear is out for revenge and race to find her before it is too late.

Episodes.Title: The Rookie S06E07
Episodes.Description: When two teenagers go missing, it is up to the entire team to find the girls and uncover the truth about their disappearance. Meanwhile, Lopez and Harper are on a different kind of investigation – the search for the perfect nanny.

Episodes.Title: The Rookie S06E08
Episodes.Description: After a mafia-related mass casualty, the team is tasked to keep the peace at the hospital. Lucy and Celina work together to investigate the suspects behind the attack. Meanwhile, Tim and Aaron embark on a metro ops mission.

Episodes.Title: The Rookie S06E09
Episodes.Description: Officer Nolan and Celina take on a special case; meanwhile, Monica enlists help to identify her attackers. Elsewhere, Lopez and Harper discover a connection to the trail of crimes.

Episodes.Title: The Rookie S06E10
Episodes.Description: Sgt. Grey helps the team prepare for their biggest mission yet. Meanwhile, Aaron, Lopez, Celina, Tim and Smitty discover a surprising connection in their case.

Episodes.Title: The Rookie S07E01
Episodes.Description: Now recovering from a gunshot wound and feeling the effects of his age, John and the team welcome two new rookies and continue the hunt for two dangerous inmates with very personal vendettas following their prison escape.

Episodes.Title: The Rookie S07E02
Episodes.Description: The team is tasked with community policing while hunting for a local vigilante. Meanwhile, Celina’s instincts are tested, and Tim and Lucy discover secrets about the two new rookies.

Episodes.Title: The Rookie S07E03
Episodes.Description: Ahead of Bailey's return home, John looks for clues to locate Jason Wyler. Then, Tim and Lucy swap rookies; a friendly face resurfaces at the station, and Wesley feels unsettled over Angela.

Episodes.Title: The Rookie S07E04
Episodes.Description: Following his stint at the LAPD, Wesley returns to the district attorney's office where his past connects him to the team's investigation. Meanwhile, Bailey and John have conflicting feelings over safety, while Lucy grows suspicious of Seth.

Episodes.Title: The Rookie S07E05
Episodes.Description: The team searches for a serial killer as Nyla struggles with the aftermath following the attack. Lucy’s relationship with Seth takes a turn, while Bailey battles her fear of Jason Wyler.

Episodes.Title: The Rookie S07E06
Episodes.Description: It’s Valentine’s Day, and Lieutenant Grey gives Tim and Lucy an unromantic assignment, while John and Celina track down a missing girl. Later, the team sharpens up for a charity gala where multiple relationships come to a head.

Episodes.Title: The Rookie S07E07
Episodes.Description: On Celina's last day as a rookie, John gives her one final test. Meanwhile, Bailey makes a new friend, and Lucy places her faith in Seth for an undercover assignment.

Episodes.Title: The Rookie S07E08
Episodes.Description: Nyla remains suspicious of Liam Glasser as a wildfire erupts, causing chaos in the city. Meanwhile, James tries to help a friend, and Seth makes a costly mistake, putting two of their own in danger.

Episodes.Title: The Rookie S07E09
Episodes.Description: The team mobilizes to locate a suspect after a deadly series of events affects one of their own. Meanwhile, Celina takes on her first case with Bailey's help.

Episodes.Title: The Rookie S07E10
Episodes.Description: John, Lucy and Angela investigate the suspicious stabbing of three teenage girls. Back at the station, the team experiences technical difficulties while managing a group of prisoners and a wild animal.

Episodes.Title: The Rookie S07E11
Episodes.Description: John and Celina find themselves in a hostage situation while undercover for a public safety initiative. While Angela and Nyla investigate the suspects, Tim challenges Lucy’s decision-making skills.

Episodes.Title: The Rookie S07E12
Episodes.Description: An April Fools' prank on LAPD’s social media leads to citywide chaos. Meanwhile, John's T.O. skills are tested, Wesley is assigned a challenging case, and Tim and Lucy play a joke on the team.

Episodes.Title: The Rookie S07E13
Episodes.Description: When anti-LAPD billboards emerge throughout the city, the team searches for who's responsible. Meanwhile, a car bombing prompts an investigation, Miles reconnects with an old friend, and John and Bailey assess their ability to adopt.

Episodes.Title: The Rookie S07E14
Episodes.Description: Tim receives a strange message, launching a larger investigation into the dark web. Meanwhile, Celina works to take down a popular podcast, and Miles helps update the department’s training videos.

Episodes.Title: The Rookie S07E15
Episodes.Description: Documentary filmmakers interview the LAPD on a complicated missing person's case connected to John.

Episodes.Title: The Rookie S07E16
Episodes.Description: The team has mixed feelings when a familiar face returns hoping to prove himself. Meanwhile, an influencer gets his fans to come after Wesley, and Tim supports Lucy as she prepares for the sergeant's exam.

Episodes.Title: The Rookie S07E17
Episodes.Description: The team helps Skip Tracer Randy when his new love interest is kidnapped. Meanwhile, Angela and Nyla enlist their moms to help catch a con artist, and Wesley is threatened to drop a case.

Episodes.Title: The Rookie S07E18
Episodes.Description: John and Harper work together to catch Oscar. Angela investigates a bank robbery. Lucy and Tim learn to adapt to her new schedule, and Miles' first date takes an unexpected turn.

Entries.Title: Chief of War
Entries.Description: Kaʻiana is summoned back home to Maui where he must decide whether to join King Kahekili in war.

Azumi Misaki, a virgin with a terrifying libido, but who doesn't want to show her plump body to others! One day, a major incident befalls Hinami!?

Episodes.Title: Nukitashi the Animation S01E03
Episodes.Description: To protect Hinami from the “Preschooler Man,” Junnosuke proudly declares himself part of the Anti-Copulation Force. However, despite appearances, Hinami turned out to be a full-fledged adult!! In the end, Junnosuke and his group had unwittingly sabotaged her chance at sex. Naturally, the sinister hand of FS draws near! He gives everything he’s got to flee, but after exhausting all his weapons, he finds himself in a desperate, do-or-die chastity crisis!!
