Entries.Title: A Dream Within a Dream
Entries.Description: During the script-reading for a period drama, Song Xiaoyu feels that it's unfair for Song Yimeng, the female lead. On the other hand, a click on the keyboard sends Song Xiaoyu into the script of Dream of Qingning.

Episodes.Title: A Dream Within a Dream S01E01
Episodes.Description: During the script-reading for a period drama, Song Xiaoyu feels that it's unfair for Song Yimeng, the female lead. On the other hand, a click on the keyboard sends Song Xiaoyu into the script of Dream of Qingning.

Episodes.Title: A Dream Within a Dream S01E02
Episodes.Description: After crossing over into Song Yimeng's body, Song Xiaoyu is surprised to find out that she has arrived six months before her wedding. It seems she now has enough time to gradually change the course of the story.

Episodes.Title: A Dream Within a Dream S01E03
Episodes.Description: Nan Heng jumps into the water as soon as he hears Song Yimeng falling into the water. While Song Yimeng is struggling, she sees Nan Heng who looks exactly like Nan Feng. Her first reaction is to never go through the plot with him.

Episodes.Title: A Dream Within a Dream S01E04
Episodes.Description: Song Yimeng doesn't know that Nan Heng is determined to kill her. She tries to bargain for her life with the Duan Blade Technique.

Episodes.Title: A Dream Within a Dream S01E05
Episodes.Description: Song Yimeng intends to be on good terms with Chu Guihong, who was just released from prison. She tells him how Nan Heng is going to put him on the spot in the imperial court.

Episodes.Title: A Dream Within a Dream S01E06
Episodes.Description: Fading River Moon is a guild hall opened in the capital by Nan Heng three years ago in secret. He has another secret identity, which is...

Episodes.Title: A Dream Within a Dream S01E07
Episodes.Description: Shangguan He advises Nan Heng to use his identity as Li Shiliu to get closer to Song Yimeng and sabotage the marriage alliance between the Song and Chu families.

Episodes.Title: A Dream Within a Dream S01E08
Episodes.Description: The real and fake Li Shiliu duke it out in Fading River Moon until the real one knocks the mask off of Chu Guihong. Only then could the people see...

Episodes.Title: A Dream Within a Dream S01E09
Episodes.Description: Li Shiliu watches as Song Yimeng lets the scroll of the Plan to Kill Heng, covered in writing, slip to the ground. A flicker of tension tightens between his brows.

Episodes.Title: A Dream Within a Dream S01E10
Episodes.Description: Nan Heng watches Song Yimeng make a wish sincerely. He tells Song Yimeng that if she can help him get the Duan Blade Technique, no matter what her wish is, he'll help her fulfill it.

Episodes.Title: A Dream Within a Dream S01E11
Episodes.Description: Concerned about the raging fire at the oil mill, Li Shiliu leads the members of Fading River Moon into the heart of the blaze to help.

Episodes.Title: A Dream Within a Dream S01E12
Episodes.Description: Under the guise of his dual identity, Nan Heng joins Song Yimeng in rebuilding the southern district. In the process, he finally uncovers the reason behind her hatred toward him.

Episodes.Title: A Dream Within a Dream S01E13
Episodes.Description: When Nan Heng visits his mother, Noble Consort Gao, he accidentally finds clues about the Duan Blade Technique in her old belongings.

Episodes.Title: A Dream Within a Dream S01E14
Episodes.Description: Song Yi Meng is in love with Li Shiliu. She refuses to marry Chu Gui Hong.

Episodes.Title: A Dream Within a Dream S01E15
Episodes.Description: The emperor interrogates Song Yimeng for instigating the two princes into starting a conflict. To protect Song Yimeng, Nan Heng barges into the imperial study room and bears the blame.

Episodes.Title: A Dream Within a Dream S01E16
Episodes.Description: Li Shiliu pays a secret visit to the Song Residence at late night. As he departs, his striking figure beneath the moonlight catches Song Yiting's eye and sparks her curiosity.

Episodes.Title: A Dream Within a Dream S01E17
Episodes.Description: To protect Chu Guihong, the emperor makes a deal with Nan Heng to cancel the marriage between the Song and the Chu families. Nan Heng and Song Yimeng feel happy about the decision but the emperor also grants a marriage between Nan Heng and Song Yimeng.

Episodes.Title: A Dream Within a Dream S01E18
Episodes.Description: Song Yimeng wants to kill Nan Heng again. She has made up her mind to protect the Song family from getting wiped out by Nan Heng.

Episodes.Title: A Dream Within a Dream S01E19
Episodes.Description: Noble Consort Gao invites a group of noble ladies and their daughters to Fanghua Hall. She says that she's going to help Nan Heng choose a concubine. In reality, she's trying to stir Song Yimeng's feelings for Nan Heng.

Episodes.Title: A Dream Within a Dream S01E20
Episodes.Description: To keep her sister from being deceived by Nan Heng, Song Yimeng resolves to take action against him.

Episodes.Title: A Dream Within a Dream S01E21
Episodes.Description: Shangguan He tells Li Shiliu everything about the blade and Song Yiting. Li Shiliu wants Shangguan He to disguise himself as Li Shiliu for one last time tomorrow and retrieve the blade.

Episodes.Title: A Dream Within a Dream S01E22
Episodes.Description: Zhou Xueyi continues to force Song Yiting to get married. She has had enough and decides to have a union with Li Shiliu when he comes for the sword. Nan Heng dresses up as Li Shiliu to meet her. He then realizes that Song Yiting has lit a drugged incense that causes him to be paralyzed.

Episodes.Title: A Dream Within a Dream S01E23
Episodes.Description: The capital is trying to arrest the Night Wandering Gods. Li Shiliu goes to their hiding spot and announces their disbandment. But they think that he's trying to protect them by saving Shangguan He himself. Due to that, they aren't willing to leave.

Episodes.Title: A Dream Within a Dream S01E24
Episodes.Description: Learning Shangguan He is going to be executed, Song Yiting asks Song Yimeng for help.

Episodes.Title: A Dream Within a Dream S01E25
Episodes.Description: Song Yimeng is stopped by Nan Heng as she leaves the execution ground. She refuses to listen to his explanation and instead demands that he give an answer to the Night Wandering Gods, who were still desperately defending him even on the eve of the execution.

Episodes.Title: A Dream Within a Dream S01E26
Episodes.Description: Nan Heng rushes over when he finds out that Song Yimeng is in danger. He fights the men in black despite his injuries.

Episodes.Title: A Dream Within a Dream S01E27
Episodes.Description: Song Yimeng hears about Gao Changying's death. Song Yude says that the rumors circulating in the Capital have pinpointed Nan Heng as the culprit. Song Yimeng insists that Nan Heng won't do something like that.

Episodes.Title: A Dream Within a Dream S01E28
Episodes.Description: Long and Hu are caught and interrogated by Chu Guihong, who resorts to brutal torture just to make them testify against Nan Heng.

Episodes.Title: A Dream Within a Dream S01E29
Episodes.Description: Chu Guihong accuses Nan Heng of ordering the assassination of Luyi. Nan Heng refutes the claim, stating that the testimony is fabricated and that the witnesses can be summoned at any time for cross-examination.

Episodes.Title: A Dream Within a Dream S01E30
Episodes.Description: The Gao Residence has been sealed off. His accomplices and everyone in his party are exiled to Han Bei. Nan Heng returns the Tiger Tally of the Armored Soldiers to His Majesty. His Majesty hands him the Crown Prince appointment decree. Nan Heng refuses by saying that he has sinned.

Episodes.Title: A Dream Within a Dream S01E31
Episodes.Description: Nan Heng arranges for a proposal at Fading River Moon. However, Song Yimeng rejects him unwillingly after his confession.

Episodes.Title: A Dream Within a Dream S01E32
Episodes.Description: Nan Heng brings Song Yimeng to the God of Matchmaker's Temple and vows to protect her and her family. Touched by his confession, Song Yimeng agrees to marry him.

Episodes.Title: A Dream Within a Dream S01E33
Episodes.Description: Nan Heng wakes up from his injury. The emperor orders the Eastern Palace to be built on the side of the inner palace for Nan Heng.

Episodes.Title: A Dream Within a Dream S01E34
Episodes.Description: Chu Guihong returns to the capital city with King Qian Yu. While Song Yimeng is waiting for Nan Heng at Fanghua Hall, she accidentally runs into King Qian Yu who calls himself the Screenwriter.

Episodes.Title: A Dream Within a Dream S01E35
Episodes.Description: Song Yimeng takes King Qian Yu to Fading River Moon to let him experience the interesting place. At the same time, she tries to convince him to respect the characters and allow them to live as they please.

Episodes.Title: A Dream Within a Dream S01E36
Episodes.Description: King Qian Yu tells Nan Heng that according to the rule of scripted world, anyone who changes their fate will suffer backlash.

Episodes.Title: A Dream Within a Dream S01E37
Episodes.Description: Song Yimeng rushes into King Qian Yu's residence and asks him if he is involved in the poisoning of the emperor and the framing of Nan Rui...

Episodes.Title: A Dream Within a Dream S01E38
Episodes.Description: Song Yimeng wakes up from a dream-like death scene. She realizes that she is back at the crown prince's residence. She is thrilled when she sees that Nan Heng is still alive.

Episodes.Title: A Dream Within a Dream S01E39
Episodes.Description: Chu Guihong changes his plans. He frames Nan Heng in advance for the poisoned mandarins the Emperor was having. He intrudes upon the Emperor's bedchamber to do the deed.

Episodes.Title: A Dream Within a Dream S01E40
Episodes.Description: The group sets up an ambush in the streets to intercept the Qianyu Army. King Qian Yu shows up and persuades the Qianyu soldiers to switch sides.

Entries.Title: Revenged Love
Entries.Description: Wu Suowei starts fresh after heartbreak, but a chance encounter with Chi Cheng leads to unexpected rivalry, mistaken love, and a bold revenge plan.

Episodes.Title: Revenged Love S01E01
Episodes.Description: Wu Suowei starts fresh after heartbreak, but a chance encounter with Chi Cheng leads to unexpected rivalry, mistaken love, and a bold revenge plan.

Episodes.Title: Revenged Love S01E02
Episodes.Description: Wu Suowei and Jiang Xiaoshuai plot a clever pursuit, orchestrating chance meetings to draw Chi Cheng in. But as Wu Suowei delves into snake-raising, the hunt takes on a life of its own.

Episodes.Title: Revenged Love S01E03
Episodes.Description: A fateful park meeting sparks new emotions as Chi Cheng and Wu Suowei hold hands for the first time. Meanwhile, an injury unveils dangerous secrets lurking in the shadows.

Episodes.Title: Revenged Love S01E04
Episodes.Description: Wu Suowei fakes intellect to lure Chi Cheng to a concert, leading to unexpected closeness in the dark and a heartfelt confession with a kiss.

Episodes.Title: Revenged Love S01E05
Episodes.Description: Showing concern, Chi Cheng visits Wu Suowei and stays the night. The next day, their flirting continues on the basketball court and Chi Cheng invites him to stay over. At first Wu Suowei refuses, but when Yue Yue shows up, he changes his mind.

Episodes.Title: Revenged Love S01E06
Episodes.Description: Wu Suowei finds out that all the sugar figurines he’s given to Chi Cheng are kept by him. Chi Cheng wants to develop the relationship further, and Wu Suowei offers a purely physical relationship, to which Chi Cheng responds admitting he still has feelings for his ex-boyfriend.

Episodes.Title: Revenged Love S01E07
Episodes.Description: Chi Cheng takes Yue Yue to meet his parents, which ends awkwardly, and Chi Cheng leaves thinking of Wu Suowei. Meanwhile, Wu Suowei finds a batch of rare snakes being sold, and suspects that they originally belonged to Chi Cheng, and decides to investigate.

Episodes.Title: Revenged Love S01E08
Episodes.Description: Wu Suowei tells Ci Cheng that he's planning to start an art installation company. In support, Ci Cheng introduces him to several CEOs who run art-related businesses. Meanwhile, out of jealousy, Weiwei tries to poison Jiltuzheng-but fails. Undeterred, she hires someone to have Jiltuzheng killed...

Episodes.Title: Revenged Love S01E09
Episodes.Description: Chi Cheng and Wu Suowei get a tip for a snake-transporting operation, and clash with Guo Chengyu’s men. Wu Suowei gets hurt and his relationship with Chi Cheng develops while hospitalized. Chi Cheng decides to resign and start a business with Wu Suowei, while Yue Yue her secret plot has been discovered.

Episodes.Title: Revenged Love S01E10
Episodes.Description: Wu Suowei’s company officially launches, and Yue Yue comes by to congratulate him and reconcile, however he rebuffs her and tells her he and Chi Cheng are together. Wu Suowei tries to go back to being straight, but this makes Chi Cheng angry who then asks Jiang Xiaoshuai for help.

Episodes.Title: Revenged Love S01E11
Episodes.Description: Wu Suo Wei, driven by jealousy, confronts Chi Cheng and reaffirms his possessiveness, demanding exclusivity. The two share intense moments with possessive dialogue and promises of commitment while planning to formalize their relationship.

Episodes.Title: Revenged Love S01E12
Episodes.Description: Wu Suo Wei and Chi Cheng's relationship deepens as they officially acknowledge their feelings, marking the start of their committed romance.

Episodes.Title: Revenged Love S01E13
Episodes.Description: Wu Suo Wei confesses his reasons for approaching Chi Cheng, and their relationship reaches a new level of sweetness. However, the relationship between Jiang Xiao Shuai and Guo Cheng Yu also changes…

Episodes.Title: Revenged Love S01E14
Episodes.Description: Lunar New Year approaches, and Chi Cheng spends time with Wu Suo Wei and his mother after his own familial obligations. However, Wang Shuo also returns, and an emotional storm is about to reach the happy couple. Meanwhile, Guo Cheng Yu seeks retribution for an injustice done to Jiang Xiao Shuai when he was younger.

Episodes.Title: Revenged Love S01E15
Episodes.Description: Suo Wei learns that Wang Shuo was hospitalized and goes to visit him, but sees an interaction between them that breaks his heart. Xiao Shuai takes Suo Wei in again, which causes a rift between him and Cheng Yu.

Episodes.Title: Revenged Love S01E16
Episodes.Description: Wang Shuo continues to cause drama between Wu Suowei and Chi Cheng, as Wu Suowei sees videos of their past relationship that makes him jealous. Meanwhile, Jiang Xiaoshuai discovers Wang Shuo's medical records and the truth comes to light.

Episodes.Title: Revenged Love S01E17
Episodes.Description: Chi Cheng lies to Wu Suo Wei about his mother's condition, and the two get in a fight, while Wang Shuo's instigations make the situation worse. Jiang Xiao Shuai and Guo Cheng Yu work together to uncover the past and the truths therein.

Episodes.Title: Revenged Love S01E18
Episodes.Description: After Wu Suo-wei's girlfriend dumps him, he decides to get revenge by seducing her new boyfriend, Chi Cheng! It started as a game, but falling in love was never part of the plan.

Entries.Title: Boiling Life
Entries.Description:
Ai Changan and Shen Xia represent Huaqi employees along with other college students who have joined the company as interns. Their stories are connected to the Chinese automobile industry from which their livelihoods depended on.

In the mid-1980s, a group of college graduates came to an automobile factory located in the northwest to start their internship. Shen Xia who intended to study abroad witnessed the development of the 7-ton truck and decides to stay. Together with Ai Chang'an, a young technician at the factory, they begin their journey to turning the tide for the industry. The market is ruthless such that the new generation of dedicated men and women face countless difficulties. The backbone of Huaqi has almost been completely dug out by opponents.

Episodes.Title: The Immortal Ascension S01E01
Episodes.Description: After teenage Han Li and Zhang Tie fail to join the Seven Mysteries Sect, a physician takes them in as apprentices. But their mentor hides a dark secret.

Episodes.Title: The Immortal Ascension S01E02
Episodes.Description: While Han Li saves Li Feiyu and learns that all of Mo's previous disciples have vanished without a trace, Zhang Tie overhears Mo plotting with Yu Zitong.

Episodes.Title: The Immortal Ascension S01E03
Episodes.Description: Han Li lies about his progress when Mo returns with a ghastly puppet. After reaching the sixth level, can he survive an attempt to possess his body?

Episodes.Description: Han Li, an ordinary, poor boy from a mountain village, joins a small martial arts sect by chance. Despite his mediocre talent, he eventually cultivates himself into an immortal through hard work and careful planning.

Episodes.Title: Prison Break S00E02
Episodes.Description: Making of Prison Break is a deeper look behind the scenes of Prison Break. In this 30-minute featurette, a variety of cast and crew speak about a wide range of aspects concerning the show, including the origins, the development, the future, the cast and characters, the writers and writing structure/style, the location itself as well as personal perspectives, decision-making, and more.

Episodes.Title: Prison Break S00E03
Episodes.Description: Description of the Joliet Correctional Center

Episodes.Title: Prison Break S00E04
Episodes.Description: Due to a political conspiracy, an innocent man is sent to death row and his only hope is his brother, who makes it his mission to deliberately get himself sent to the same prison in order to break the both of them out, from the inside out.

Episodes.Title: Prison Break S00E05
Episodes.Description: Due to a political conspiracy, an innocent man is sent to death row and his only hope is his brother, who makes it his mission to deliberately get himself sent to the same prison in order to break the both of them out, from the inside out.

Episodes.Title: Prison Break S00E06
Episodes.Description: A special episode, recapping the second season episodes, including behind the scenes footage and cast interviews.

Episodes.Title: Prison Break S00E07
Episodes.Description: Amanda Byram goes behind the scenes of the hit American drama, talks to some of the show's stars, and looks forward to forthcoming plot twist.

Episodes.Title: Prison Break S00E08
Episodes.Description: Sara has been jailed for murder. Wanting to make an example of her, the government has sent her to a women's prison and she faces 25 years to life. Heavily pregnant and fearful for her life, Sara must survive by making an alliance with an old enemy... but she's a marked woman and various attempts on her life lead Michael to take drastic action.

Episodes.Title: Prison Break S00E09
Episodes.Description: Michael, Lincoln and co reunite to break out an increasingly vulnerable Sara.

Episodes.Title: Prison Break S00E10
Episodes.Description: In this 30-minute special, join the cast and creators of PRISON BREAK as they take us behind-the-scenes of what promises to be their biggest escape yet.

Episodes.Title: Prison Break S01E01
Episodes.Description: Michael Scofield, a structural engineer, attempts to rob a bank in order to get incarcerated at Fox River State Penitentiary, where his brother Lincoln Burrows, accused of murdering the Vice President's brother, is scheduled to be executed. At Fox River, Michael approaches a number of inmates, all of whom play an important role in his plan to free his brother from the inside. Meanwhile, agents Kellerman and Hale are determined to make sure the execution goes through as planned. Lincoln's son LJ gets into trouble.

Episodes.Title: Prison Break S01E02
Episodes.Description: Michael seeks help of his fellow prison inhabitants to execute his escape plans.

Episodes.Title: Prison Break S01E03
Episodes.Description: When Michael reveals his escape plan to Sucre, Sucre chooses to be no part of it, and requests a cell transfer. Michael gets a new cellmate called Haywire.

Episodes.Title: Prison Break S01E04
Episodes.Description: Veronica keeps uncovering new information regarding Lincoln's case and decides she wants to work on the case full-time.  When no one wants to help her on the case, Nick Savrinn (an attorney) offers his assistance and the two of them visit Lincoln.

Episodes.Title: Prison Break S01E05
Episodes.Description: Kellerman and Hale blackmail Warden Pope. Michael finds out he might get out earlier than anticipated. Veronica becomes uncertain of her allies.

Episodes.Title: Prison Break S01E06
Episodes.Description: Michael creates a lockdown by sabotaging the air conditioning in order to execute his breakout plan properly, and unintentionally causes a riot that gets Sara into huge trouble. Meanwhile, an ex-con is blackmailed into seeing to that Lincoln is killed.

Episodes.Title: Prison Break S01E07
Episodes.Description: While the riot intensifies, Abruzzi and Sucre join forces. Michael must decide whether or not to save the life of Dr. Tancredi.

Episodes.Title: Prison Break S01E08
Episodes.Description: Michael finds out a storeroom fundamental to his escape plans has been converted into a break room. Veronica and Nick are being threatened.

Episodes.Title: Prison Break S01E09
Episodes.Description: Abruzzi's demotion in the prison hierachy puts the entire escape plan at risk. Michael finds himself in the uneviable position of trying to protect T-Bag's new "fish" and facing the threat of T-Bag exposing the plan to the guards. The inmates dig themselves into a hole.

Episodes.Title: Prison Break S01E10
Episodes.Description: Michael is forced to give up Fibonacci's location to Philly Falzone, and Kellerman and Hale get a little unwanted help to track down LJ who has gone missing. Veronica and Nick uncover evidence against the man Lincoln was convicted of murdering.

Episodes.Title: Prison Break S01E11
Episodes.Description: The escapees and Dr. Tancredi are shocked when they learn the identity of Michael's visitor, who brings with her a very important piece of the escape plan.

Episodes.Title: Prison Break S01E12
Episodes.Description: Michael sees proof his plan is working, so he begins to overcome the last obstacle. As the escape draws near, the group tries to reduce its number by one and targets T-Bag.

Episodes.Title: Prison Break S01E13
Episodes.Description: With Lincoln's execution scheduled for the following day, Veronica comes out of hiding to contact him and gains an ally. Kellerman makes the ultimate sacrifice to preserve the conspiracy. Michael looks for a way to get Lincoln out of solitary confinement in time for the escape that evening. The inmates risk everything as they attempt their escape.

Episodes.Title: Prison Break S01E14
Episodes.Description: Veronica and Nick request a judge to postpone Lincoln's execution. A C.O. becomes suspicious about a broken door.

Episodes.Title: Prison Break S01E15
Episodes.Description:
As Lincoln is about to be executed, he briefly sees his father in the viewing room. A phone call from judge Kessler delays the execution. After reviewing the newly surfaced evidence, the judge orders the exhumation of Steadman's body.

Michael creates a new, more dangerous, break-out plan, involving going through the prison yard. An accident puts Michael's new plan in danger.

Episodes.Title: Prison Break S01E16
Episodes.Description: Flashbacks shed light on the past actions that led to the incarceration of Lincoln, Sucre, T-Bag and C-Note. Basis of Michael's ingenious break-out plan are revealed. Dr. Tancredi memorizes how she ended up in Fox River State Penitentiary.

Episodes.Title: Prison Break S01E17
Episodes.Description: Lincoln is worried about Michael's sanity while Michael has trouble remembering some parts of the prison schematics. Sucre has to conceal the hole in the guard's break room. Warden Pope transfers Michael to solitary after he declines his request.

Episodes.Title: Prison Break S01E18
Episodes.Description: In an effort to recreate the missing piece of the tattoo, Michael gets transferred to the psych ward, seeking the help of Haywire. T-Bag and C-Note have to join forces.

Episodes.Title: Prison Break S01E19
Episodes.Description: Michael must get the key to the infirmary and enlist the help of an old face, while Lincoln learns the identity of his kidnapper and another inmate learns of the escape.

Episodes.Title: Prison Break S01E20
Episodes.Description: Westmoreland wants Michael to speed up the planned escape, and gets Bellick one step closer to unraveling it. Michael has to decide whether to involve Sara in the breakout plan. Tweener's devotion is put to a test. Veronica finds out that her ally unexpectedly has a connection to an inmate serving time at Fox River.

Episodes.Title: Prison Break S01E21
Episodes.Description: Everyone's ready to make their escapes across the high wire. Veronica and Nick realize they may be in over their heads. And Agent Kellerman helps Vice President Reynolds calm down before her debate.

Episodes.Title: Prison Break S01E22
Episodes.Description: As the escape is in progress, Warden Pope and Captain Bellick begin a search to detain the escapees. Michael and co. have to reach the aircraft fast as the police is hot on their heels. Veronica discovers a major piece of evidence that could prove Lincoln's innocence. The Vice President is worried about losing her authority.

Episodes.Title: Prison Break S02E01
Episodes.Description: As eight hours has passed since the escape, Michael, Lincoln, Sucre, C-Note and Abruzzi attempt to evade their seekers. Bellick is forced to relinquish the command of the search party to FBI Special Agent Alexander Mahone whose ingenious approach makes Michael's life as a fugitive harder. As a result from her overdose, Dr. Tancredi is in critical condition. A short-handed T-Bag faces the ultimate challenge.

Episodes.Title: Prison Break S02E02
Episodes.Description: Mahone tries to lure the escapees by targeting an imprisoned LJ. Michael and Lincoln come up with a plan to free LJ from jail. Sucre, Abruzzi and C-Note have a plan of their own, but only to break free of their pursuers.Meanwhile, Bellick and Warden Pope feel the heat following their unsuccessful attempts to capture the escapees.Tweener infiltrates a bunch of college students on their way to spring break.

Episodes.Title: Prison Break S02E03
Episodes.Description: Michael and a wounded Lincoln try to outmaneuver Mahone, who is hot on their trail. Sara gets a surprise visit to her bedside.Following his suspension, Bellick recruits a resolute partner to aid in his quest to get the escapees behind the bars.Sucre and C-Note head out for their family reunions-regardless of being observed by the authorities.

Episodes.Title: Prison Break S02E04
Episodes.Description: Bellick, now teamed up with Michael, Lincoln and Nika, sets out to find the money stolen by Westmoreland during the 1971 skyjacking. Kellerman targets Sara, who receives a long-awaited phone call. T-Bag gets a ride from an unsuspecting family. Abruzzi resumes the search for Fibonacci to settle the scores once and for all.

Episodes.Title: Prison Break S02E05
Episodes.Description: Michael and Lincoln are eager to locate the Double K ranch where Westmoreland hid his millions. Sucre goes to Las Vegas to prevent Maricruz from marrying his cousin Hector. C-Note gets on a train. Mahone is given an important package.

Episodes.Title: Prison Break S02E06
Episodes.Description: Mahone takes an interest in the story of DB Cooper.In their quest to find Westmoreland's treasure, Michael and Lincoln travel house-to-house in Utah. Haywire's journey outside the prison walls continues. Sucre bumps into an acquaintance.

Episodes.Title: Prison Break S02E07
Episodes.Description: Michael, Sucre, T-Bag and C-Note claim the hidden treasure.An anxious Lincoln risks everything to get to LJ. LJ grows wary about the easy getaway. Kellerman rethinks where his loyalties lie after Sara gets to The Company's hit list. Mahone results to deadly force to get the truth out of Tweener.

Episodes.Title: Prison Break S02E08
Episodes.Description: In his efforts to try to get hold of all of the money Sucre runs into some unexpected difficulties. And Captain Bellick and his partner have not given up on finding their old inmates.

Episodes.Title: Prison Break S02E09
Episodes.Description: In an effort to learn more about his pursuer Michael cozies up to Mahone's wife. L.J. and Lincoln have a bumpy road-trip. T-Bag receives a surprise, and C-Note's wife must choose between her daughter and husband.

Episodes.Title: Prison Break S02E10
Episodes.Description: As Michael reunites with Sara, Mahone and Kellerman strive to make sure they stay apart.On the road with LJ, Lincoln meets his father. Sucre tries to contact Maricruz. T-Bag has a reunion of his own.

Episodes.Title: Prison Break S02E11
Episodes.Description: As Lincoln tries to reunite with Michael, he has to say goodbye to another loved one. Michael attempts to obtain a getaway plane. T-Bag gets revenge. Sara and Kellerman face-off.

Episodes.Title: Prison Break S02E12
Episodes.Description: With Mahone on their trail, Michael, Lincoln, their father, and Sucre make a run for the getaway plane. Michael's reunion with his father sheds light on his difficult childhood.The women in Bellick and Kellerman's lives coerce their men to confess their sins.A medical emergency forces C-Note to risk it all.

Episodes.Title: Prison Break S02E13
Episodes.Description: Bellick is anything but happy about his sudden homecoming-to Fox River.Elsewhere, Michael and Lincoln might face a homecoming of their own. Mahone and Kellerman use everything they got to make certain that Michael and Lincoln do not get through their road trip alive.Sucre's getaway plane encounters some difficulties. T-Bag closes on Mrs. Hollander.

Episodes.Title: Prison Break S02E14
Episodes.Description: Bellick gets a taste of the medicine he gave out when he was the Captain and Agent Mahone's ex-wife makes another appearance.

Episodes.Title: Prison Break S02E15
Episodes.Description: In Mexico, Sucre gets a car but gets in trouble by the police. Bellick has more trouble as the new inmate as prisoners who suffered with him want revenge.

Episodes.Title: Prison Break S02E16
Episodes.Description: C-Note gets into a tricky situation when a robber holds up the diner he is in and demands everyone go into the storage room until the police arrive. Michael, Lincoln and Kellerman get closer to revealing the conspiracy with the help of Sara. Mahone finds a new ally in Bellick.

Episodes.Title: Prison Break S02E17
Episodes.Description: Michael and Sara request Henry Pope's help to retrieve the information that will topple The Company.Mahone pins down an escapee. Sucre discovers a new threat while hitchhiking to reunite with Maricruz. T-Bag brings the Hollander family to his home.

Episodes.Title: Prison Break S02E18
Episodes.Description: T-Bag digs deep and finds his 'nice-side' with the help of a psychiatrist. Michael, Lincoln, and Sara get their hands on evidence needed to bring down The Company, while Kellerman is close to finding the President.

Episodes.Title: Prison Break S02E19
Episodes.Description: An unlikely alliance forms between Bellick and Sucre while Michael is determined to face the president. T-Bag gets into some trouble when he loses his luggage and C-Note faces major consequences after some of his actions.

Episodes.Title: Prison Break S02E20
Episodes.Description: Sara sacrifices herself for the safety of Michael so the brothers can get on with their final plan to attain freedom, but their plan gets 'shipwrecked'. Meanwhile, Bellick blackmails Sucre to partner up as T-Bag's streak of murder continues to the south of the border.

Episodes.Title: Prison Break S02E21
Episodes.Description: The day has finally come for Sara's trial while critical information that will exonerate her is being debunked. Meanwhile, Michael is determined to get his hands on the 5 million and to stop T-Bag's reign of terror. Bellick is also money hungry and will do whatever it takes to hunt down T-Bag. Kellerman decides his fate while Lincoln and Mahone square off.

Episodes.Title: Prison Break S02E22
Episodes.Description: Michael tries to save his brother and himself from the unstoppable Mahone. Kellerman's testimony at Sara's trial proves different from what was expected, could this be the end for Sara? Sucre puts everything on the line to save his Maricruz. Just like old times, T-Bag and Bellick are at it again but this time there will be a winner.

Episodes.Title: Prison Break S03E01
Episodes.Description: Now locked up in a Panamanian prison known as Sona, Michael, T-Bag, Bellick, and Mahone try to find a way out. Much to their devastation, they soon find out that the prison has been abandoned by the authorities because of the immense threat from the vile inmates. Michael seeks for an inmate named Whistler in the prison sewers. As Lincoln is puzzled by Sara's sudden disappearance, he learns that LJ has gotten into some trouble. He also tries to recover the 5 million dollars.

Episodes.Title: Prison Break S03E02
Episodes.Description: Michael and Mahone try to lure Whistler out of his hiding place. T-Bag gains some upward momentum in the prison hierarchy as the water supply is running low. Lincoln meets familiar and not so familiar faces on his quest to free Michael.

Episodes.Title: Prison Break S03E03
Episodes.Description: Whistler tells the truth to Michael. Michael tries to get in touch with Sara but the only phone is in Lechero's quarters, so he has to rely on T-Bag's help. Mahone battles his addiction. Bellick steps on some toes.

Episodes.Title: Prison Break S03E04
Episodes.Description: After taking delivery of a package from The Company, Lincoln realizes that they are deadly serious. Michael's new break out plan relies on electricity. Haywire is back from the dead, haunting disoriented Mahone. Bellick and T-Bag get special attention from Lechero.

Episodes.Title: Prison Break S03E05
Episodes.Description: A new inmate named Tyge is brought to Sona. After he seemingly recognizes Whistler, Michael's doubts arise. T-Bag enters a new area of commerce.Lincoln goes to the seaside with Sofia. Sucre takes over the side-business of his predecessor.

Episodes.Title: Prison Break S03E06
Episodes.Description: Michael threatens to cancel the escape plan unless he sees a proof that Sara is still alive. Whistler is accused of murdering an inmate and it is up to Michael to prove his innocence and save his life. Lincoln and Sofia help in monitoring the morning guards. Mahone may have another way to get out of Sona.

Episodes.Title: Prison Break S03E07
Episodes.Description:
Everything goes wrong for Michael as he tries to create a diversion.

Lincoln tries to outsmart Susan who has his son. Sucre offers his assistance to Lincoln.

Episodes.Title: Prison Break S03E08
Episodes.Description: Susan jeopardizes Michael's life as she puts her own escape plan into motion. Whistler's past catches up to his girlfriend.The Company goes after Lincoln and Sucre. Justice prevails for Mahone. And Lechero sheds light into an empty tunnel.

Episodes.Title: Prison Break S03E09
Episodes.Description: The Panamanian Army arranges Michael to get a taste of solitary. T-Bag reserves a spot in the escape. Bellick's life turns into an uphill battle. Susan traps Sucre.

Episodes.Title: Prison Break S03E10
Episodes.Description: Lechero's demotion devastates Michael's breakout plan as Sammy takes reigns at Sona. T-Bag forces Bellick to fight in a fight where the odds are stacked heavily against him. Lincoln and Sucre have some surprise fireworks set for Susan.

Episodes.Title: Prison Break S03E11
Episodes.Description: Michael's escape may be in jeopardy because of heavy rain. T-Bag and Lechero join forces, while Bellick hopes to do the same with Mahone.

Episodes.Title: Prison Break S03E12
Episodes.Description: Michael, Whistler, and Mahone make their break from Sona. But Mahone seems like the odd man out along the way.

Episodes.Title: Prison Break S03E13
Episodes.Description: Michael and Lincoln are left with no choice but to hand Whistler over in exchange to save LJ and Sofia. A familiar face enters Sona while another inmate leaves.

Episodes.Title: Prison Break S04E01
Episodes.Description: Michael has trailed Gretchen/Susan, Whistler and Mahone to L.A. Chaos reigns in SONA while T-Bag, Bellick and Sucre go missing. Lincoln and L.J. continue to stay with Sofia.

Episodes.Title: Prison Break S04E02
Episodes.Description: "Breaking & Entering" is the 59th episode of the American television series Prison Break and was shown together with the first episode of its fourth season as a two-hour episode with "Scylla". It was broadcast on September 1, 2008 in the United States on the Fox Network.

Episodes.Title: Prison Break S04E03
Episodes.Description: Michael attempts to track the cardholder and avoid going back to prison. Wyatt finds new information regarding Sara's whereabouts. Elsewhere, T-Bag uses a new identity to make a new life for himself.

Episodes.Title: Prison Break S04E04
Episodes.Description: Michael, Lincoln and Sucre must crash a police benefit to obtain the next card key. Reeling from another death, Sara falls back into an old habit. T-Bag arouses suspicion and runs into some old “friends” his first day on the job.

Episodes.Title: Prison Break S04E05
Episodes.Description: Self locates another card hidden in a safe within a secure federal building, as Mahone continues his quest for revenge. Meanwhile, T-Bag's new life may be in jeopardy.

Episodes.Title: Prison Break S04E06
Episodes.Description: The entire operation may be in jeopardy when Mahone gets into trouble with the law. Gretchen's sister receives a surprise visitor. The Company may be onto Self. T-Bag continues to raise suspicions at Gate.

Episodes.Title: Prison Break S04E07
Episodes.Description: Lincoln takes members of the team to Las Vegas where Sucre gets an indecent proposal. Sara learns about Michael’s condition, and Roland pushes his luck too far. Gretchen teams up with T-Bag who makes an offer to Michael he cannot refuse. Meanwhile, the secrets in Whistler’s bird book are finally revealed.

Episodes.Title: Prison Break S04E08
Episodes.Description: Lincoln works to retrieve the final card, which is being held by the General. Michael and Self are forced to work with Gretchen. Meanwhile, Roland continues to be berated for losing the transcribing device in Las Vegas.

Episodes.Title: Prison Break S04E09
Episodes.Description: Wyatt gets a taste of his own medicine, and Mahone finds some resolution. T-Bag scrambles when the police investigate his missing co-worker while Gretchen gets cozy with a Company man. Meanwhile, Michael’s condition continues to worsen, and a team member makes the ultimate sacrifice while planning the underground break-in for Scylla.

Episodes.Title: Prison Break S04E10
Episodes.Description: Sara is left with no choice but to take Michael to the hospital as his condtion rapidly worsens. Sucre and Lincoln are faced with unknown territory as they are left in charge of the operation. Elsewhere, agent Self makes a surprising ally.

Episodes.Title: Prison Break S04E11
Episodes.Description: Michael races against time and his ailing health to break into the Company headquarters to steal Scylla, but the break-in’s success lies with Sucre. Gretchen dresses up for a meeting with the General and one final attempt to get the last card key. T-Bag must make a decision to leave his criminal ways for good.

Episodes.Title: Prison Break S04E12
Episodes.Description: Sara takes a hostage in a bid to secure Scylla. In the meantime, Michael and Lincoln finally meet the General while one of their members switches allegiance.

Episodes.Title: Prison Break S04E13
Episodes.Description: It's up to Michael to hold the gang together after they find out they were betrayed by one of their own. Meanwhile, Gretchen is blackmailed by T-Bag's new partner.

Episodes.Title: Prison Break S04E14
Episodes.Description: Michael, whose condition is deteriorating, winds up in the hands of The Company who promise Lincoln that they can save Michael's life in exchange for a favor. Elsewhere, Gretchen and Self wind up with Scylla and a buyer.

Episodes.Title: Prison Break S04E15
Episodes.Description: Michael gets medical attention from the most unlikely of places, and Charles Westmoreland returns to help uncover the true meaning of Scylla. Meanwhile, Lincoln and Sucre race to stop Gretchen before Scylla is lost forever.

Episodes.Title: Prison Break S04E16
Episodes.Description: Lincoln and his new partners arrive in Miami to recover Scylla from its shocking new owner, and Sara searches for a missing Michael who learns some surprising information about his past. Meanwhile, a double-crossing leads to a death and an arrest in "The Sunshine State."

Episodes.Title: Prison Break S04E17
Episodes.Description: Michael and Sara journey to Miami while Lincoln meets with his mother. T-Bag and Self's mission to locate Scylla takes a dramatic turn. The General comes under pressure.

Episodes.Title: Prison Break S04E18
Episodes.Description: Michael and Lincoln come to blows over Scylla as Christina sets the wheels in motion for her plan. Meanwhile, Sara receives life-changing news. T-Bag arrives at the Indian Embassy. The General becomes increasingly paranoid.

Episodes.Title: Prison Break S04E19
Episodes.Description: Michael's reunion with Christina is soured when she drops a bombshell regarding Lincoln, and T-Bag grows determined to prove he is worthy of being a member of the Company.

Episodes.Title: Prison Break S04E20
Episodes.Description: Pandemonium erupts at the hotel following the assassination, and Christina puts the final pieces of her plan together. Meanwhile, the General makes good on his threat, and Michael is forced to choose between saving either Lincoln or Sara.

Episodes.Title: Prison Break S04E21
Episodes.Description: Familiar faces return to help Michael end his quest to bring down The Company once and for all.

Episodes.Title: Prison Break S04E22
Episodes.Description: Michael tries to bring down the Company once and for all.

Episodes.Title: Prison Break S05E01
Episodes.Description: It's been seven years since Michael was presumed dead, but when clues suggest that he might still be alive, Lincoln reunites with Sara to help track down the truth.

Episodes.Title: Prison Break S05E02
Episodes.Description: As Lincoln and C-Note search for the "Sheik of Light," Michael and his cellmate, Whip, attempt an escape from Ogygia. Meanwhile, Sara's investigation into Michael's reappearance leads her to the state department and an uneasy reunion with Paul Kellerman.

Episodes.Title: Prison Break S05E03
Episodes.Description: When T-Bag ambushes Sara, he warns her that two of Poseidon's henchmen, Van Gogh and A&W, may be following her. Meanwhile, Lincoln attempts to retrieve his confiscated passport to escape Yemen, and Michael plans his next move.

Episodes.Title: Prison Break S05E04
Episodes.Description: Michael, Whip and Ja make their last attempt to break from Ogygia, but must make a deal with the devil to do so. Lincoln races against the clock to help with the escape, as T-Bag meets with Kellerman to gather more info on Michael's resurrection.

Episodes.Title: Prison Break S05E05
Episodes.Description: Lincoln becomes frustrated as he tries to understand what really happened to Michael. C-Note has a new escape plan, but fears it will not be executed quickly enough, as Cyclops is trailing closely behind. Meanwhile, Sara struggles with the idea that Michael may be alive.

Episodes.Title: Prison Break S05E06
Episodes.Description: As Michael, Lincoln and the remaining Ogygia gang try to escape Yemen, they find themselves racing though the desert from a vengeful Cyclops. Meanwhile, A&W and Van Gogh question their roles as their pursuit of the escapees leads them to...Graceland.

Episodes.Title: Prison Break S05E07
Episodes.Description: Sara becomes fearful of her family's safety when she discovers the real reason that Michael faked his own death. In the meantime, Michael and Lincoln continue to try find a way home with the help of Sucre, and the real identity of Poseidon is revealed.

Episodes.Title: Prison Break S05E08
Episodes.Description: When Sara and her son's safety is threatened, Michael and Lincoln recruit the help of Sheba and C-Note to try and catch Poseidon. Meanwhile, Whip goes on a separate mission and T-Bag reveals a secret.

Episodes.Title: Prison Break S05E09
Episodes.Description: Dangerous threats keep Michael and Lincoln fighting to protect Sara and Mike. Meanwhile, Poseidon continues to try and outsmart Michael and the rest of the gang, which leads them to the ultimate showdown, and not everyone makes it out alive.

Episodes.Title: Law & Order S01E01
Episodes.Description: When a young woman dies during a hectic emergency room night shift, her father claims the hospital was negligent, and an investigation leads the detectives to believe that the doctor treating her may have been drunk on duty.

Episodes.Title: Law & Order S01E02
Episodes.Description: The shooting of two black men by a white woman in a crowded subway initially appears to be a case of self-defense, but further investigation reveals revenge as a possible motive.

Episodes.Title: Law & Order S01E03
Episodes.Description: The death of a man with AIDS appears to be the work of a serial killer who may have been motivated by mercy.

Episodes.Title: Law & Order S01E04
Episodes.Description: Stone has difficulty prosecuting a privileged preppie with a history of abusing his girlfriends after one of them dies at his hands.

Episodes.Title: Law & Order S01E05
Episodes.Description: Greevey and Logan have a hunch that robbery is a cover for the real motive in the death of a millionaire in a parking garage.

Episodes.Title: Law & Order S01E06
Episodes.Description: The mugging of a councilman leads the detectives to arrest a mobster, who in turn leads Stone and Robinette to corrupt city officials.

Episodes.Title: Law & Order S01E07
Episodes.Description: When Logan and Greevey investigate how a family man came to be found unconscious in Central Park, they uncover a very high-class call girl operation run by a well-educated socialite.

Episodes.Title: Law & Order S01E08
Episodes.Description: The shooting of a black honors student stirs up racial tensions, especially after it becomes apparent that the cop responsible for the death may have planted a gun on the body to excuse the shooting.

Episodes.Title: Law & Order S01E09
Episodes.Description: During the investigation into the death of a little girl in a respectable, middle-class family, Greevey and Logan uncover a myriad of family secrets involving abuse, molestation, and murder.

Episodes.Title: Law & Order S01E10
Episodes.Description: A city arts commissioner and a socialite come under investigation when an artist noted for his sadomasochistic themes is found dead under suspicious circumstances.

Episodes.Title: Law & Order S01E11
Episodes.Description: Greevey and Logan's investigation into a black teenager's claim that she was raped by white policemen is hampered by a publicity hungry, black politician who will not grant the detectives access to the victim.

Episodes.Title: Law & Order S01E12
Episodes.Description: Stone faces pressure from the public and from Schiff as he prepares to prosecute the person accused of bombing an abortion clinic.

Episodes.Title: Law & Order S01E13
Episodes.Description: Police start a citywide manhunt for a man suspected of killing a cop during a rooftop pursuit.

Episodes.Title: Law & Order S01E14
Episodes.Description: Greevey and Logan reopen an investigation to help Stone and Robinette build a stronger case against three boys accused of gang-raping a TV reporter.

Episodes.Title: Law & Order S01E15
Episodes.Description: An assault on a candy storeowner leads Stone and Robinette to build a case against a powerful mafia don.

Episodes.Title: Law & Order S01E16
Episodes.Description: Stone tries to salvage his prosecution of the Masucci family when Beigel faces bribery charges and seems willing to turn against his brother-in-law.

Episodes.Title: Law & Order S01E17
Episodes.Description: The accidental shooting of two children by a 14-year-old hired killer leads to a drug dealer and a real estate agent.

Episodes.Title: Law & Order S01E18
Episodes.Description: Stone faces a flashy Texas lawyer and a hostile community as he tries to prosecute a young man accused of killing a drug dealer.

Episodes.Title: Law & Order S01E19
Episodes.Description: Two brothers appear to be the logical suspects in the murder of their wealthy parents.

Episodes.Title: Law & Order S01E20
Episodes.Description: Logan is forced to face his cultural biases when both a Cuban drug dealer and an Irish terrorist are suspected of killing a Lebanese gunrunner.

Episodes.Title: Law & Order S01E21
Episodes.Description: Stone and Robinette prosecute a surgeon and the wealthy father of a transplant patient for illegally obtaining a kidney.

Episodes.Title: Law & Order S01E22
Episodes.Description: Cragen comes under suspicion when his mentor in the department is investigated for laundering drug money.

Episodes.Title: Law & Order S02E01
Episodes.Description: Logan crosses the line in order to obtain a confession from the man suspected of murdering Max Greevey. Stone finds that his prosecution is placed in jeopardy because of Logan's actions.

Episodes.Title: Law & Order S02E02
Episodes.Description: A double homicide casts suspicion on both the ex-wife and the former boyfriend of the murdered duo, with the dead man's murdered son holding the key to the mystery.

Episodes.Title: Law & Order S02E03
Episodes.Description: A lethal drug overdose leads the detectives to an aggressive stage mother and a pornographic movie producer.

Episodes.Title: Law & Order S02E04
Episodes.Description: The conviction of a homeless man for murder is threatened on appeal based on the lack of a search warrant for his "home", which was a lean-to in Central Park.

Episodes.Title: Law & Order S02E05
Episodes.Description: A couple faces trial after they deny medical help to their daughter based on their religious beliefs.

Episodes.Title: Law & Order S02E06
Episodes.Description: The mugging of a pregnant legal secretary leads to a case involving her lover, her boss and charges of murder when she loses the baby.

Episodes.Title: Law & Order S02E07
Episodes.Description: The renovation of a brownstone uncovers the remains of a boy who disappeared 31 years earlier, reviving a wrenching and long-suppressed memory in his childhood friend and neighbor.

Episodes.Title: Law & Order S02E08
Episodes.Description: The detectives investigate the gang rape of a college student during a fraternity Holloween party.

Episodes.Title: Law & Order S02E09
Episodes.Description: A hit-and-run investigation leads to the discovery of a schoolteacher carrying on an affair with one of her students. Cerreta and Logan suspect that she may have manipulated him into killing her husband.

Episodes.Title: Law & Order S02E10
Episodes.Description: The investigation into a social-club fire which claimed 53 fatalities leads to a connection between arson, illegal immigrants and the sale of green cards.

Episodes.Title: Law & Order S02E11
Episodes.Description: The discovery of a frozen corpse in a dumpster leads to rival Broadway producers.

Episodes.Title: Law & Order S02E12
Episodes.Description: An obsessive fan pleads temporary insanity when he is charged with attempting to murder the soap-opera actress who is the center of his life.

Episodes.Title: Law & Order S02E13
Episodes.Description: Stone faces an old rival in court as he tries to link a hit man and three murders to a sleazy lawyer and a powerful man behind bars.

Episodes.Title: Law & Order S02E14
Episodes.Description: An apparent mugging ends in the death of a wealthy woman but the case comes to hang on a silver pin that may have been in the victim's possession.

Episodes.Title: Law & Order S02E15
Episodes.Description: Stone is determined to see that a teenage boy doesn't get away with murder twice when the young man is brought to trial for the shooting death of one of his friends.

Episodes.Title: Law & Order S02E16
Episodes.Description: The parents of a murdered woman contest Stone's prosecution of her killer so that he can be extradited to their home state, where the death penalty still exists.

Episodes.Title: Law & Order S02E17
Episodes.Description: Cerreta and Logan investigate the accusation that a nun in charge of a shelter for teens molested a young addict.

Episodes.Title: Law & Order S02E18
Episodes.Description: The discovery of a dead baby leads to a case involving a slumlord who would not provide any heat and who defends her actions by blaming the rent laws.

Episodes.Title: Law & Order S02E19
Episodes.Description: The brutal murder of a Jewish jeweler appears to be a hate crime, but the investigation soon leads back to the man's brother and his shady business deals.

Episodes.Title: Law & Order S02E20
Episodes.Description: When a Chinese-American honors student is killed, the investigation uncovers a racist mother who's son was competing with the victim for the same scholarship.

Episodes.Title: Law & Order S02E21
Episodes.Description: A politician opposes the prosecution of his son's murderer because it might mean revealing that his late son was gay.

Episodes.Title: Law & Order S02E22
Episodes.Description: The murder of a Wall Street legend begins a case involving an ailing union worker and a former governor and old friend of Schiff's.

Episodes.Title: Law & Order S03E01
Episodes.Description: When a sleazy photographer is murdered, his models appear to be the most likely suspects.

Episodes.Title: Law & Order S03E02
Episodes.Description: The assassination of an African-American leader leads to the arrest of a man whose ex-wife was suspected of having an affair with the victim.

Episodes.Title: Law & Order S03E03
Episodes.Description: A priest-turned-lawyer uses race and class as the basis for his defense of a young Mexican man who murdered his wealthy girlfriend after she broke up with him.

Episodes.Title: Law & Order S03E04
Episodes.Description: A teenager's fatal heart attack is traced to fraud and greed on the part of the manufacturer of his pacemaker and their supplier.

Episodes.Title: Law & Order S03E05
Episodes.Description: The discovery of a young woman's body in the river leads to an investigation of illegal sweatshops and the enslavement of young immigrants.

Episodes.Title: Law & Order S03E06
Episodes.Description: Dr. Olivet accuses her gynecologist of rape, but Stone finds his case in trouble when he discovers that Olivet tape-recorded the crime.

Episodes.Title: Law & Order S03E07
Episodes.Description: Cerreta and Stone find themselves on opposite sides of the fence when a storeowner kills two robbers and then claims self-defense as a justification.

Episodes.Title: Law & Order S03E08
Episodes.Description: Cerreta poses as a weapons dealer to help Stone build a case against a Columbian hit man, but the deal takes an unexpected turn, resulting in bloodshed.

Episodes.Title: Law & Order S03E09
Episodes.Description: Logan gets a new partner and Stone faces an old friend from law school as they investigate a woman's claim of self-defense in the shooting death of a small time hood.

Episodes.Title: Law & Order S03E10
Episodes.Description: An engineer and a tribal chief become the chief suspects in the death of a Nigerian woman who died while smuggling heroin internally.

Episodes.Title: Law & Order S03E11
Episodes.Description: The apparent abduction of a little girl by her natural mother becomes complicated by charges of sexual molestation.

Episodes.Title: Law & Order S03E12
Episodes.Description: After Stone accepts a plea bargain from the much younger and poorer lover of a wealthy older woman found murdered in her apartment, he begins to have doubts that he has sent the right man to prison, especially as he learns more about the attorney who handled the woman's estate.

Episodes.Title: Law & Order S03E13
Episodes.Description: The confession of an elderly man that he assisted his wife in committing suicide doesn't fully satisfy Stone when rumors surface that the man was once a Nazi collaborator.

Episodes.Title: Law & Order S03E14
Episodes.Description: The investigation into the murder of a young physician leads to the discovery of an unorthodox and illegal relationship between her fiance and his psychiatrist.

Episodes.Title: Law & Order S03E15
Episodes.Description: The absence of a murder weapon complicates the investigation into the murder of a drug addict who stole from her family to support her habit.

Episodes.Title: Law & Order S03E16
Episodes.Description: Stone battles the Brooklyn DA's office over prosecutorial jurisdiction in the case of a mentally handicapped man who confesses to the stabbing deaths of two women.

Episodes.Title: Law & Order S03E17
Episodes.Description: Stone and the police battle the closed ranks of the Navy to investigate the death of a female Naval officer during a party in a Manhattan hotel.

Episodes.Title: Law & Order S03E18
Episodes.Description: The initial investigation into the death of a research scientist leads to an animal-rights group until evidence surfaces that her husband's affair with a coworker may point to a possible motive for the murder.

Episodes.Title: Law & Order S03E19
Episodes.Description: While investigating several deaths at a diabetes clinic, Briscoe and Logan discover that teenage computer hackers may have tampered with the clinic's medical database.

Episodes.Title: Law & Order S03E20
Episodes.Description: When a Romanian immigrant kills, his lawyer announces he will plead his client "not guilty due to cultural insanity" claiming the man had been conditioned to violence in his homeland.

Episodes.Title: Law & Order S03E21
Episodes.Description: The statement of a drug dealer who survived a shoot-out that killed a cop leads Logan and Briscoe to suspect that the cop died because he was gay and his fellow officers were reluctant to back him up.

Episodes.Title: Law & Order S03E22
Episodes.Description: Logan and Briscoe begin their investigation into the death of a hearing-impaired young woman by questioning her two most recent boyfriends.

Episodes.Title: Law & Order S04E01
Episodes.Description: A guest is murdered on-air on a controversial talk show. Meanwhile Logan and Briscoe have a new boss, Lt. Anita Van Buren, and Stone gets a new collague;  the police and district attorney attempt to prosecute the show's abrasive host.

Episodes.Title: Law & Order S04E02
Episodes.Description: A disruptive, unbalanced homeless man is found severely beaten in an alley of the middle class neighborhood he calls home, leading Stone to try and prosecute one of the residents for premeditated murder.

Episodes.Title: Law & Order S04E03
Episodes.Description: A college student charges an admittedly promiscuous rock star with rape, but he claims the act was consensual.

Episodes.Title: Law & Order S04E04
Episodes.Description: Stone finds himself up against an ambitious black lawyer defending a white, racist serial killer.

Episodes.Title: Law & Order S04E05
Episodes.Description: The police suspect a cover up when they receive an anonymous tip that a wealthy man was murdered by his wife, who refuses to allow an autopsy after a physician declares that the death occurred from natural causes.

Episodes.Title: Law & Order S04E06
Episodes.Description: A 17-year-old boy becomes the chief suspect in the murder of his father, raising questions of self-defense and abuse that the family does not want to face.

Episodes.Title: Law & Order S04E07
Episodes.Description: Stone and Kincaid try to prove that the young woman believed to have planted a bomb in a parking garage had been brainwashed and was acting under the direct orders of a charismatic cult leader.

Episodes.Title: Law & Order S04E08
Episodes.Description: A skeleton unearthed at a building site resurrects one of Stone's old cases, and brings him face to face with the tenacious, brilliant culprit, who is seeking a new trial.

Episodes.Title: Law & Order S04E09
Episodes.Description: A lawyer decides to defend her teenage client charged with murder as an adult with the claim that he's violent because of a genetic predisposition due to an extra Y chromosome.

Episodes.Title: Law & Order S04E10
Episodes.Description: A "green-card" bride from Russia is suspected of murdering her rich, but cold husband, who was threatening to divorce her just weeks before she would qualify to remain in this country.

Episodes.Title: Law & Order S04E11
Episodes.Description: An emaciated elderly woman is found dead of an apparent heart attack and her granddaughter is charged with neglect and grave indifference to human life.

Episodes.Title: Law & Order S04E12
Episodes.Description: A millionaire friend of Schiff's won't cooperate with the police following his son's kidnapping.

Episodes.Title: Law & Order S04E13
Episodes.Description: While investigating a woman's claim that she passed out in a taxi and awoke to find her newborn missing, Briscoe and Logan uncover a scam involving private adoptions.

Episodes.Title: Law & Order S04E14
Episodes.Description: A phone call threatening a woman's young daughter leads to a case that causes Kincaid to resign from Schiff's office because of an affair in her past.

Episodes.Title: Law & Order S04E15
Episodes.Description: A 14-year-old's shooting death involves the son of a former police detective, who's also an old friend of Briscoe's.

Episodes.Title: Law & Order S04E16
Episodes.Description: A scientist becomes the chief suspect when his estranged wife, who's been delaying divorce proceedings, is the victim of a letter bomb.

Episodes.Title: Law & Order S04E17
Episodes.Description: During a 24-hour period, Briscoe and Logan have a heavy caseload that includes 5 unrelated murders and a domestic quarrel, which results in the maiming of the husband.

Episodes.Title: Law & Order S04E18
Episodes.Description: Briscoe and Logan bet that the killing of a star athlete's father is linked to gambling debts and threats to the baseball player's family.

Episodes.Title: Law & Order S04E19
Episodes.Description: A black minister fans the flames of racial intolerance after a hit-and-run in Harlem claims the life of a 12-year-old and the Jewish driver isn't indicted.

Episodes.Title: Law & Order S04E20
Episodes.Description: Briscoe and Logan investigate the disappearance of a child from her abusive foster home and find her being held by a loving but disturbed woman who insists she has acted only for the child's own good.

Episodes.Title: Law & Order S04E21
Episodes.Description: An assailant breaks the wrist of a tennis player prior to a tournament, and a competitor is among the suspects.

Episodes.Title: Law & Order S04E22
Episodes.Description: A truck hits a pedestrian and the investigation reveals the victim's link to a baby-food company in which a new partner has connections to the Russian mob.

Episodes.Title: Law & Order S05E01
Episodes.Description: A woman's death exposes an unorthodox method of treating cancer that Executive Assistant DA McCoy intends to prove is negligent homicide.

Episodes.Title: Law & Order S05E02
Episodes.Description: A comedy-club owner comes under suspicion for having shot his wife, now comatose with a bullet in her head, after it's discovered he was abusive and she was about to divorce him.

Episodes.Title: Law & Order S05E03
Episodes.Description: The killing of a Japanese nightclub owner who was visiting New York leads to the arrest of a singer who once worked for the deceased, and whose lawyer uses the ""battered-woman syndrome"" as a defense.

Episodes.Title: Law & Order S05E04
Episodes.Description: After it's determined that a wealthy woman did not commit suicide but was murdered, the detectives question both her first and second husbands and her teenage daughter.

Episodes.Title: Law & Order S05E05
Episodes.Description: A routine investigation uncovers evidence that leads Briscoe and Logan to a long-time fugitive, a radical Vietnam War opponent on the run since a 1971 burglary that left a policeman dead.

Episodes.Title: Law & Order S05E06
Episodes.Description: When Lt. Van Buren is the victim of an attempted holdup by two teens, she fires her gun and kills one of them, and the detectives are faced with the fact that she shot an unarmed child in the back.

Episodes.Title: Law & Order S05E07
Episodes.Description: When Briscoe and Logan suspect that a missing infant may have been murdered by her parents rather than kidnapped, they uncover a terrible family secret which hides a mentally ill serial killer.

Episodes.Title: Law & Order S05E08
Episodes.Description: McCoy uses a charge of ""larceny by extortion"" against a councilman, whose former colleague claims he demanded sex in exchange for a law-firm partnership.

Episodes.Title: Law & Order S05E09
Episodes.Description: Among the suspects in a lawyer's murder are a swindler, who conned a woman out of her family fortune, and the woman's once-wealthy son.

Episodes.Title: Law & Order S05E10
Episodes.Description: The killing of a man who had served as a juror in a mob trial leads to a battle of wills between McCoy and his long-time friend, the suspect's attorney.

Episodes.Title: Law & Order S05E11
Episodes.Description: After the body of a young female junkie is identified as the daughter of a wealthy family, Briscoe and Logan try to find out who left her to die in the yard of a day-care center.

Episodes.Title: Law & Order S05E12
Episodes.Description: The investigation into the killing of an abortion clinic doctor leads to an activist group led by a former priest.

Episodes.Title: Law & Order S05E13
Episodes.Description: A Wall Street broker accused of murdering his mentor uses the defense of ""black rage"" in court.

Episodes.Title: Law & Order S05E14
Episodes.Description: Briscoe and Logan set out to identify the apparent victim in a snuff film, but find her alive and really the victim of a points-for-sex club at her prestigious high school.

Episodes.Title: Law & Order S05E15
Episodes.Description: A routine investigation into a woman's death leads Briscoe and Logan to a fertility doctor guilty of unethical practices, but who cannot apparently be touched because of confidentiality rules, and patient reluctance to talk.

Episodes.Title: Law & Order S05E16
Episodes.Description: The shooting of a board member of an exclusive private school leads to a blue-collar family and a classist system.

Episodes.Title: Law & Order S05E17
Episodes.Description: A bomb at a construction site kills a 12-year-old boy, and the suspects include the bankrupt contractor and a jealous husband.

Episodes.Title: Law & Order S05E18
Episodes.Description: The investigation into a double murder leads to a young alcoholic whose family once lived in the victims' house and who had admitted to his AA group that he's had nightmares about killings.

Episodes.Title: Law & Order S05E19
Episodes.Description: The death of an autistic youth in custody reveals a multitude of unusual and possibly illegal therapies being used, but also parents reluctant to pursue a prosecution.

Episodes.Title: Law & Order S05E20
Episodes.Description: Logan relives unhappy childhood memories when a friend is found dead, a presumed suicide, until the investigation reveals recent contact with a former priest, with a history of pedophilia.

Episodes.Title: Law & Order S05E21
Episodes.Description: The investigation into a taxi driver's murder involves a loan shark, a forged check, a missing plumber and the victim's wife.

Episodes.Title: Law & Order S05E22
Episodes.Description: Suspects in a psychiatrist's murder include the victim's ex-husband, a patient suffering from multiple-personality disorder and her obstructive father.

Episodes.Title: Law & Order S05E23
Episodes.Description: A gay city councilman is murdered and the trail leads to a bigoted rival politician and a male prostitute.

Episodes.Title: Law & Order S06E01
Episodes.Description: Briscoe and his new partner, Det. Reynaldo Curtis, investigate the murder of a young girl who disappeared between school and her music lesson, with a blurry film from an ATM machine as their clue.

Episodes.Title: Law & Order S06E02
Episodes.Description: Briscoe and Curtis have a hard time finding cooperative witnesses when investigating the murder of a college student at a rough biker bar.

Episodes.Title: Law & Order S06E03
Episodes.Description: McCoy and Kincaid clash over the death penalty as McCoy prosecutes a man who murdered an undercover cop during a drug bust.

Episodes.Title: Law & Order S06E04
Episodes.Description: A triple murder at a magazine publishing company leads to a case of sibling rivalry, a protective matriarch and a corrupt judge.

Episodes.Title: Law & Order S06E05
Episodes.Description: When the detectives solve a series of murders committed by a holdup team in ski masks, McCoy must determine whether a young woman found with them is an unwilling hostage, or an active participant in the crimes.

Episodes.Title: Law & Order S06E06
Episodes.Description: Briscoe and Curtis try to solve a co-ed's murder after a graphic description appears online, while McCoy finds himself up against a lawyer who is reluctant to reveal   elements of her client's past.

Episodes.Title: Law & Order S06E07
Episodes.Description: The investigation into a prostitute's murder leads to a married plastic surgeon as the obvious suspect, but Kincaid has a hunch that an elaborate frame-up is in play.

Episodes.Title: Law & Order S06E08
Episodes.Description: A mother claiming that her baby was kidnapped while she was at confession retraces her steps and actions with Curtis, which raises legal questions later when her attorney introduces a unique defense.

Episodes.Title: Law & Order S06E09
Episodes.Description: A hidden anti-Semitic message in a high school yearbook offers a clue to an art teacher's murder and leads to a case that matches McCoy against "Klan lawyer" Roy Payne.

Episodes.Title: Law & Order S06E10
Episodes.Description: The victim in a 30-year-old rape and stabbing case is fearful when information received by Briscoe and Curtis creates the possibility of a new trial for the perpetrator.

Episodes.Title: Law & Order S06E11
Episodes.Description: The death of a show horse leads to a trial involving insurance fraud, a sting operation and a wealthy woman's disappearance.

Episodes.Title: Law & Order S06E12
Episodes.Description: McCoy finds that his career is on the line when his former female assistant and ex lover accuses him of forging evidence that helped put an innocent man in prison.

Episodes.Title: Law & Order S06E13
Episodes.Description:
A subway station gas attack, similar to one that took place in a Baltimore church five years earlier, brings Baltimore detectives Tim Bayliss and Frank Pembleton to New York to assist Briscoe and Curtis.

This crossover continues on Homicide: Life on the Street S04E12 For God and Country (II).

Episodes.Title: Law & Order S06E14
Episodes.Description: Paul Robinette places the system on trial when he defends a young black woman accused of kidnapping her biological baby from his white, adoptive parents.

Episodes.Title: Law & Order S06E15
Episodes.Description: A jogger killed in Central Park turns out to be the second wife of a former comedy club owner, who was acquitted of killing his first wife. And convicting him this time may hinge on tracing the path of a Columbian coin used as a subway token slug.

Episodes.Title: Law & Order S06E16
Episodes.Description: A down-on-his-luck ad executive becomes the prime suspect when his wife and son are killed, and his daughter wounded on a night that he claims was spent drinking.

Episodes.Title: Law & Order S06E17
Episodes.Description: When a young attorney is murdered shortly after he decides to file a sexual harassment claim against his employer, Briscoe and Curtis quickly discover that the alleged harasser and his wife each have an excellent motive for murder.

Episodes.Title: Law & Order S06E18
Episodes.Description: The investigation into the murder of a model with a passion for cocaine and partying focuses on the men in her life --  a nightclub owner, a basketball player, a photographer and a limousine driver.

Episodes.Title: Law & Order S06E19
Episodes.Description: A woman is shot while sleeping, and the investigation leads the police to a boy whose crack-addicted mother has entrusted him to a dealer's care.

Episodes.Title: Law & Order S06E20
Episodes.Description: After a college co-ed's body is found, the detectives look for a campus rapist, but the medical examiner's report puts them on a different path, one involving prostitution.

Episodes.Title: Law & Order S06E21
Episodes.Description: The investigation into multiple homicides at a clothing store leads to the arrest of a schizophrenic who presents McCoy with a formidable opponent when he decides to represent himself.

Episodes.Title: Law & Order S06E22
Episodes.Description: After an infant is found dead in his crib, it's determined he was poisoned, and all evidence points to the child's au pair.

Episodes.Title: Law & Order S06E23
Episodes.Description: After Briscoe, Curtis, McCoy, and Kincaid witness the execution of a criminal they brought to justice, their unique reactions to the event culminate in personal tragedies for each of them.

Episodes.Title: Law & Order S07E01
Episodes.Description: McCoy's new second chair, ADA Jamie Ross, is determined to prosecute as harshly as possible a carjacker who took the life of a teacher as she   pleaded for her life on an audio tape discovered at the crime scene.

Episodes.Title: Law & Order S07E02
Episodes.Description: The cops tackle identifying a corpse left in an elevator, and McCoy finds his prosecution of the suspect later hampered by a vindictive judge who resents Ross's in-court rebuke for sexual harassment.

Episodes.Title: Law & Order S07E03
Episodes.Description: Briscoe and Curtis have to break the mutual alibi of two girlfriends as they try to find the killer of a young black man, whose angry parents pressure McCoy to indict a young woman who claims the victim had raped her.

Episodes.Title: Law & Order S07E04
Episodes.Description: Briscoe and Curtis's investigation of the murder of a rare coin dealer nets them a millionaire as a suspect, but Ross has to play detective too as the DA's office tries to establish a provenance for the missing coin collection.

Episodes.Title: Law & Order S07E05
Episodes.Description: Curtis, angered by the attitude of an old colleague of Briscoe's, looks beyond the findings of an IAB investigation and turns up evidence of police corruption that puts the DA's office into competition with an ambitious judge and Briscoe under investigation for stealing evidence from a police lockup.

Episodes.Title: Law & Order S07E06
Episodes.Description: The murder of a janitor in a university laboratory building leads back to a student employee whose participation in a drug study may have prompted the crime.

Episodes.Title: Law & Order S07E07
Episodes.Description: The murder of a deadbeat father whose son is dying of leukemia presents McCoy and Ross with a sympathetic suspect and a moral dilemma.

Episodes.Title: Law & Order S07E08
Episodes.Description: The murder of Richard Speigel, chief financial officer for an exclusive, family-owned department store goes from the sitting room to the bedroom and into the board room as suspicion shifts from co-workers to family members.

Episodes.Title: Law & Order S07E09
Episodes.Description: The case against Huey Tate, a young man accused of shooting the well-known leader of the African-American Congress comes undone when the New York authorities learn that their chief witness was once an informant for the FBI, and is still under their protection.

Episodes.Title: Law & Order S07E10
Episodes.Description: The sidewalk shooting of a young husband uncovers the fact that his wife's first husband died in a inadequately investigated accident, and that they may have been having an affair before it happened.

Episodes.Title: Law & Order S07E11
Episodes.Description: The detectives face a difficult struggle getting witnesses to a girl's apparent suicide to come forward while Ross tries to prove that a known bully is the one really responsible for her actions.

Episodes.Title: Law & Order S07E12
Episodes.Description: An unpromising case of murder suddenly develops new leads when the cops explore the possibility that the victim was mistaken for someone else. McCoy walks a thin line in the matter of ethical conduct as he tries to make a case against a lendor who uses unscrupulous methods to collect the money owed to him.

Episodes.Title: Law & Order S07E13
Episodes.Description: The discovery of a would-be thief refocuses a murder investigation, leaving the prosecutors the task of making a conspiracy case against the deceased's attorney and the pretty young widow.

Episodes.Title: Law & Order S07E14
Episodes.Description: The murder of an ex-cop with a penchant for blackmail and illicit sex brings feminist lawyer Lanie Stieglitz into court against McCoy to defend a suburban wife and mother.

Episodes.Title: Law & Order S07E15
Episodes.Description: A headless corpse fished out of the river sends Briscoe and Curtis out to Los Angeles to obtain a blood sample from their chief suspect while McCoy and Ross back in New York try to obtain a court order for the procedure.

Episodes.Title: Law & Order S07E16
Episodes.Description: Back in New York with their suspect, Briscoe and Curtis try to pin down his schedule on the night of the murder, but find instead that another man was in the area at the right time and more importantly, might have a motive for the crime. But after the issuance of a new arrest warrant, McCoy and Ross have to fly to LA to defend their warrant against attacks by the man's defense counsel, Ross's former husband Neal Gorton.

Episodes.Title: Law & Order S07E17
Episodes.Description: The trial of Eddie Newman begins but the prosecution's chances of conviction are hampered by a "dream team" of defense attorneys, Gorton's personal pressures on Ross, the public questioning of the relationship between Curtis and Lisa Lundquist, and a surprise accusation.

Episodes.Title: Law & Order S07E18
Episodes.Description: McCoy becomes obsessed with nailing a serial rapist recently released on parole and pushes the cops perilously close to harassment as he attempts to connect the man with a new rape and murder matching his previous M.O.

Episodes.Title: Law & Order S07E19
Episodes.Description: The cops' best hope of finding a kidnapped hired car driver alive is one of the armed robbers who grabbed him after a job, but the immunity deal he demands in return would effectively preclude his prosecution for the shooting death of an off-duty cop, placing McCoy in a difficult position as he seeks to placate the cops, who want the guy prosecuted, and the kidnapped man's wife, who wants every avenue of saving her husband explored.

Episodes.Title: Law & Order S07E20
Episodes.Description: A young man who claims to have helped a murdered young man change a flat tire is first the cops' primary suspect, then the prosecutors' chief witness.

Episodes.Title: Law & Order S07E21
